dossier.claim: Several passages alter the balance between Illya's vulnerability, her asserted control, and her casual contempt. The strongest examples concern who directs a departure or halt, why she is frightened, and what she means by granting Sakura special treatment.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese makes these distinctions explicit: Illya says she will take Sakura away, while Berserker’s halt is narrated without an order from her. Shirou objects to either Rin or Illya being injured and identifies approaching death alongside Berserker’s defeat as grounds for Illya’s fear. Elsewhere, animal classification and the promise to treat Sakura as human give precise form to her contempt.
dossier.englishEffect: The English reverses Illya's stated agency in Sakura's departure and adds her command to Berserker's halt. It narrows Shirou's expressed concern to Rin and reduces the immediate explanation of Illya's fear to witnessing her Servant's death. In the hostile dialogue, it removes specific animal and human-status distinctions. The rescue discussion also changes leaving Master status from part of a projected change into a concession.
dossier.limits: These are local shifts with different directions, not evidence that the English consistently weakens Illya's agency or removes her cruelty. It preserves Shirou's trust that she will listen, her possessive claim over his life, explicit sadistic threats, and her acknowledgment that she does not survive the ending under discussion. These examples do not establish a broader change to her distance from ordinary life, and bonus-scene jokes cannot by themselves establish her main-story characterization. The park conversation still enacts her disconcerting ease about killing him, so its omitted delivery label is not counted separately.
dossier.diagnostic: 252 findings in this category; 7 cited passages.

findings.sourceReading: 自分たち以外のマスター…サーヴァントさえ呼んでしまえば outsiders only needed to call respective spirits.
findings.explanation: Outsider Masters expendable after summoning becomes after founders have own Servants.

contexts.japanese: 自分たち以外のマスターなんて、サーヴァントさえ呼んでしまえば
contexts.english: As long as they had their own Servants, the other Masters were just obstacles

findings.description: Greater Grail has not itself achieved Third Magic becomes cannot use it.
findings.sourceReading: 成し得た訳ではない denies accomplishment by Grail itself; summoned inherently capableAvenger not system’s achievement.
findings.explanation: Greater Grail has not itself achieved Third Magic becomes cannot use it.

contexts.japanese: 大聖杯自体が第三魔法を成し得た訳ではないわ
contexts.english: the grail itself isn't capable of using the Third Magic.

findings.description: Narrator unknown warped creed becomes villagers ignorant of own creed.
findings.sourceReading: 教義どう歪んでいたかは知らない Illya’s historical knowledge limit.
findings.explanation: Narrator unknown warped creed becomes villagers ignorant of own creed.

contexts.japanese: 彼らの教義がどう歪んでいたかは知らない。
contexts.english: They didn't know how twisted their creed was.

findings.description: Narrator cannot explain arriving at idea becomes people did not know own choice.
findings.sourceReading: どうしてそんな考えに至ったか判らない speaker doesnotknoworigin.
findings.explanation: Narrator cannot explain arriving at idea becomes people did not know own choice.

contexts.japanese: どうしてそんな考えに至ったかなんて判らない。
contexts.english: They didn't know why they chose to do what they did.

findings.description: Poor and externally isolated becomes outsiders see them wretched.
findings.sourceReading: 貧しく外界から隔離 actual poverty/isolation state.
findings.explanation: Poor and externally isolated becomes outsiders see them wretched.

contexts.japanese: 貧しく、外界から隔離された彼らにとって
contexts.english: From the outside, they seemed poor and wretched.

findings.description: Humanity-defining pride becomes mistreatment as subhuman.
findings.sourceReading: 唯一の誇りが人間以下の彼らを人間たらしめる self/the narrator’s hierarchy and salvific self-definition.
findings.explanation: Humanity-defining pride becomes mistreatment as subhuman.

contexts.japanese: 人間以下である彼らを人間たらしめる唯一の誇り
contexts.english: when they were treated as less than human.

findings.description: Negating all innate functions becomes many functions including extreme emotions.
findings.sourceReading: 機能すべて否定 includes hunger/slaughter/lovehate as innatefunctions, blanket impossiblepurity ideal.
findings.explanation: Negating all innate functions becomes many functions including extreme emotions.

contexts.japanese: 予め人に付属された機能すべてを否定して
contexts.english: rejected the many functions humans were born with, such as hunger, slaughter, and extreme love and hate.

findings.description: All sins knowable to them becomes all crimes known to humanity.
findings.sourceReading: 彼らが知り得る全て localpeoplepossibleknowledge scope.
findings.explanation: All sins knowable to them becomes all crimes known to humanity.

contexts.japanese: 彼らが知り得る全ての罪業を与え
contexts.english: They charged him with every crime known to man

findings.description: Different method becomes wrong method.
findings.sourceReading: 方法は違えど differentkindofsalvation/heroism, peopleview him hero.
findings.explanation: Different method becomes wrong method.

contexts.japanese: 方法は違えど、
contexts.english: The methods might be wrong

findings.description: No special merits becomes no gains.
findings.sourceReading: 何の取り得もなかった describes ordinaryperson lacking noteworthyqualities/abilities.
findings.explanation: No special merits becomes no gains.

contexts.japanese: 何の取り得もなかった
contexts.english: without gaining anything from it.

findings.description: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.
findings.sourceReading: 魔であれと定めた socialmandate constitutedrole.
findings.explanation: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.

contexts.japanese: 周りの人間がそいつに魔であれと定めたのだ。
contexts.english: the people around him decided that he was evil anyway.

findings.description: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken explains the skull-masked Assassin's wish to leave his own name in history and become an original, enduring as a record.
findings.explanation: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう訝しがるでない。おぬしの求める聖杯はあちらの娘だ。歴史に名を残し、自らが本物になる。記録としての永遠を望むうぬの願いはアインツベルンが叶えてくれよう。
contexts.english: "Don't be so suspicious. She is the Holy Grail you seek. She will leave her name in history and become the original. The Einzberns can grant your wish of being recorded in history.

findings.description: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.
findings.sourceReading: Her assuming the original or proper form is necessary for granting the wish; the following instruction concerns waiting for ritual dress.
findings.explanation: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.

contexts.japanese: だが、それにはあの娘に本来の姿になって貰わねばならん。ワシはホムンクルスは管轄外でな。あやつらが正装を整えるまでは好きにさせておけばよい」
contexts.english: But you will need to take it once she reverts to her original form. Homunculi are out of my area of expertise. Let her do what she wants until the dress is ready."

findings.description: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin understands the present policy as not forcing her, responding to Zouken permitting preparation and claiming cooperation.
findings.explanation: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.

contexts.japanese: 「…………無理強いはしない、という事か。
contexts.english: "...So you didn't force her to come.

findings.description: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.
findings.sourceReading: The escaping party is in the process of passing through the castle gate after slipping the old mage's grasp.
findings.explanation: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.

contexts.japanese: 油断しきった老魔術師の手をすり抜け、城門を抜けつつあった。
contexts.english: They slipped through the careless old mage's grasp and are headed for the castle gate.

findings.description: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.
findings.sourceReading: The narration presents Zouken's confidence that Illya cannot escape her inherited purpose: even if released, she will cooperate and come to the Grail's heart herself.
findings.explanation: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.

contexts.japanese: 何が起ころうとイリヤスフィールは逃げだせない。
contexts.english: No matter what happens, he will not let Illyasviel escape.

contexts.japanese: あの白い娘は、もはや臓硯が手を放したところで自分から協力する。
contexts.english: That pale girl is willing to cooperate with Zouken, even without his urging.

findings.description: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.
findings.sourceReading: Her lack of rebuttal suggests she cannot deny possible mistakes at the crucial moment.
findings.explanation: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.

contexts.japanese: 反論しないあたり、本人もここ一番でドジをかます可能性を否定できないらしい。
contexts.english: But she doesn't deny that she's the person most likely to make careless mistakes.

findings.description: Likely other disciples becomes unqualified other disciples.
findings.sourceReading: Illya infers with でしょうね that frequent worldly interactions likely mean other disciples.
findings.explanation: Likely other disciples becomes unqualified other disciples.

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ。けどゼルレッチは魔法使いの中でも頻繁に俗世に関わる変人だから、弟子は他にもいるでしょうね。
contexts.english: "Yeah. But Zelretch is an eccentric who interacts with the everyday world especially often for a Magician, so he has other disciples.

findings.description: Trial use becomes trying something.
findings.sourceReading: Rin and Illya plan a trial firing or test of the new weapon and ask boy to rest.
findings.explanation: Trial use becomes trying something.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂、じゃないわよ。わたしとイリヤは試し打ちをしてくるから、士郎は少しでも体を休めて—って、どうしたのよその手……！」
contexts.english: "Don't give me that. Illya and I are going to try something, so settle down and—hey, what's happened to your hand!?"

findings.description: Around dawn becomes before dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.
findings.explanation: Around dawn becomes before dawn.

contexts.japanese: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
contexts.english: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"

findings.description: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.
findings.sourceReading: She says the new act is an application of magecraft/far-seeing shown before, though this time impressive.
findings.explanation: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.

contexts.japanese: 前に見せた魔術の応用だけど、今度のはすごいんだよ。
contexts.english: Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.
findings.sourceReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

contexts.japanese: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
contexts.english: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.

findings.description: Cancellation cliché becomes going straight to ending.
findings.sourceReading: Saying our battle has only just begun gets the series cut short/canceled; Taiga stops stock canceled-manga final line.
findings.explanation: Cancellation cliché becomes going straight to ending.

contexts.japanese: あ、それダメ。その台詞を言うと打ち切りになるから止めて。
contexts.english: Hey, don't say that. Lines like that go straight to the ending, so stop.

contexts.japanese: 押っ忍！　わたしたちの戦いはまだ始まったばかりだぜー！
contexts.english: Ossu! Our battle has just begun!

findings.description: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.
findings.sourceReading: Illya affection 4 or lower blocks True; source also says even one extra Projection is too much.
findings.explanation: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.

contexts.japanese: ぶっちゃけ、わたしの好感度が４以下だったり、投影を一回でも多く使ってるとトゥルーには行けないのでしたー！
contexts.english: To be blunt, if my affection level is below 4 or you use too many Projections, you can't reach the True ending!

findings.description: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.
findings.sourceReading: After Illya calls her overbearing, Taiga triumphantly asks whether Illya has finally noticed, thirty-nine episodes in.
findings.explanation: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.

contexts.japanese: うむ、三十九回目にしてようやく気づいたかっ！
contexts.english: And I finally realized now that we're at the 39th episode!

contexts.japanese: そーなんだー。ネタバレとよく違いが分からないけど、とにかく師しょー横暴だー。
contexts.english: Uh-huh, okay. I don't know how that's different from a spoiler, but your house, your rules, Master.

findings.description: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
contexts.english: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.
findings.sourceReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

contexts.japanese: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"

findings.description: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.
findings.sourceReading: However radically she is transformed, if Illya remains inside he recognizes known person.
findings.explanation: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.

contexts.japanese: 「……たとえ、どんなに変わり果ててしまっても。
contexts.english: "No matter how this ends...

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.
findings.sourceReading: Illya murmurs 滑稽ね, comical, aloud.
findings.explanation: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.

contexts.japanese: 滑稽ね、とイリヤは呟く。
contexts.english: She finds it rather comical.

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.
findings.sourceReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

contexts.japanese: 手遅れも何もない。
contexts.english: She was never ready to begin with.

contexts.japanese: そもそも間桐桜がイリヤスフィールに手を伸ばした時点で、もう、何もかもが手遅れだった。
contexts.english: From the moment Sakura reached for Illya, it was already over.

findings.description: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.
findings.sourceReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

contexts.japanese: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
contexts.english: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

findings.description: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

contexts.japanese: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
contexts.english: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."

contexts.japanese: 「……いいでしょう。自分で探す手間が省けますから。
contexts.english: "...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.

findings.description: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.
findings.sourceReading: 決着をつけるコトにした says Sakura has decided to bring the matter to a conclusion.
findings.explanation: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.

contexts.japanese: 「それに、サクラは決着をつけるコトにしたんでしょう？
contexts.english: "And you've settled your scores, haven't you?

findings.description: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.
findings.sourceReading: 今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がない is now wanting to kill everyone so badly she can't help it, contradicting her earlier choice to avoid killing.
findings.explanation: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.

contexts.japanese: 誰も殺したくないから受け入れたのに、今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がないなんて、矛盾してるわよサクラ」
contexts.english: You let that part of you in because you didn't want to kill anyone else, but now you're saying you have to kill them all. You're contradicting yourself, Sakura."

findings.description: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

contexts.japanese: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
contexts.english: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

findings.description: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou expects irreparable consequences unless he tells Illya about both dangers.
findings.explanation: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯の暗躍と、あの、正体不明の影についても話しておかないと、取り返しのつかない事になるだろう。
contexts.english: I have a feeling that everything will change once I bring up Zouken's schemes and that unknown Shadow.

findings.description: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou objects because either Rin or Illya will be injured if they fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「それもあるけど。遠坂、イリヤと戦ったらただじゃ済まないぞ。始めたらどっちかが必ず傷を負う。そういうのは嫌だ。俺は、もともと」
contexts.english: "That too. But Tohsaka, you won't get out unscathed if you fight her. You're bound to get hurt once you start. I don't want that to happen. To begin with—"

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.
findings.sourceReading: Narration asks how he interpreted/received what she said before he advances roaring.
findings.explanation: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.

contexts.japanese: それをどう取ったのか。
contexts.english: Did he hear it?

findings.description: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Illya vaguely realizes escape from her fear is impossible, and the narration then states that Berserker stops.
findings.explanation: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.

contexts.japanese: この不安、恐怖からは逃げられない、と少女は漠然と悟り—黒い巨人は足を止めた。
contexts.english: Vaguely realizing that there's no escape from this dread, from this fear, the girl orders the dark giant to stop.

findings.description: Chuckle good in delight is malformed.
findings.sourceReading: The old man laughs with evident amusement while Illya looks coldly.
findings.explanation: Chuckle good in delight is malformed.

contexts.japanese: 愉快げに笑う老人を、少女は冷淡な瞳で見つめる。
contexts.english: The girl watches the old man coldly as he chuckles good in delight.

findings.description: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is merely a receptacle into which material is poured/which is filled.
findings.explanation: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はただ注がれるだけのもの。
contexts.english: It is merely to fill the Grail.

findings.description: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.
findings.sourceReading: Illya mocks Zouken as 当事者, one directly involved/concerned with the arrangement, for forgetting it.
findings.explanation: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.

contexts.japanese: —ま、当事者である貴方がソレを忘れるぐらいだから、マキリの血は衰退したんでしょうけど」
contexts.english: ...The Makiri bloodline really must have fallen into ruin, if even a founder has forgotten that."

findings.description: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.
findings.sourceReading: The hypothetical medicine prolongs life by only less than one day.
findings.explanation: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.

contexts.japanese: おぬしとて木々の一本一本が寿命を延ばす妙薬とすれば、この森など瞬く間に食らいつくそう。たとえそれが、僅か一日足らずの延命だとしてもな。
contexts.english: If you knew that each tree in this forest could be made into a drug to extend your life, even you would cut down the whole forest in an instant. Even if it only meant an extra day of life.

findings.description: A distant-sky comparison becomes a literal upward stare at the sky.
findings.sourceReading: The old magus focuses his eyes as though looking toward some distant sky, momentarily arrested by her ancestral question.
findings.explanation: A distant-sky comparison becomes a literal upward stare at the sky.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は、何か、遠い空を見上げるように眼を凝らし。
contexts.english: The old mage stares up at the sky in contemplation.

findings.description: Perception becomes spirit.
findings.sourceReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.
findings.explanation: Perception becomes spirit.

contexts.japanese: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
contexts.english: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

findings.description: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.
findings.sourceReading: The Shadow mercilessly swallows prey caught in a spiderweb-like situation; metaphor does not enumerate victims.
findings.explanation: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.

contexts.english: swallowing every last prey within its web.

findings.description: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing their verbal fight won't produce a decision, both women hand final choice to him.
findings.explanation: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.

findings.explanation: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.

contexts.english: "...Hmph. You like making children happy, huh? You're pretty childish yourself, Emiya. Don't tell me you're into little girls?"

findings.description: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Illya clings to Shirou with the biggest possible smile after promising to protect him from Rin.
findings.explanation: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.

contexts.japanese: にぱっ、とこれ以上ない笑顔で抱きついてくるイリヤ。

findings.description: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that his explanation has lurched from instinctive choice to a claim about being Illya's guardian.
findings.explanation: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.

contexts.japanese: あう、我ながらメチャクチャな論理展開。
contexts.english: Aargh. The man doth protest too much, methinks.

findings.description: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.
findings.sourceReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

contexts.japanese: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
contexts.english: buffet me so violently I can't even see.

contexts.japanese: ……緊張で麻痺した耳には、狂戦士の咆哮と、強い風鳴りと、
contexts.english: ...In my ears gone numb from stress, the fierce howling of the wind and the mad warrior's roars

findings.description: The English adds disembowelment to the apparent corpse while retaining uncertainty through 'looks like.' This supports a separate finding about added gore, not a claim about Saber's motives.
findings.sourceReading: Something resembling Berserker's corpse is sinking into the Shadow.
findings.explanation: The English adds disembowelment to the apparent corpse while retaining uncertainty through 'looks like.' This supports a separate finding about added gore, not a claim about Saber's motives.

contexts.japanese: 目の前に剣を突きつけられ、セイバーの背後では、バーサーカーの亡骸らしきものが、黒い影に沈んでいた。
contexts.english: Behind Saber, something that looks like the eviscerated corpse of Berserker sinks into the dark Shadow.

findings.description: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.
findings.sourceReading: Illya faces both her Servant's defeat and death immediately threatening her.
findings.explanation: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.

contexts.japanese: 自らのサーヴァントの敗北と、目前に迫った死。
contexts.english: Illya just watched her Servant die in battle.

findings.description: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.

findings.explanation: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの元気のなさは何処にいったのか、イリヤは一変して桜を睨んだ。
contexts.english: Illya glares at Sakura, all of her earlier enthusiasm gone.

findings.description: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

findings.explanation: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

contexts.english: "...Yes. I carried you there. Sakura told me to protect you. I merely obeyed her order, as her Servant."

findings.description: A quotation-reporting connective becomes Shirou saying 'Huh.'

findings.explanation: A quotation-reporting connective becomes Shirou saying 'Huh.'

contexts.japanese: と。
contexts.english: Huh.

findings.description: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.

findings.explanation: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.

contexts.english: "Oh wow, really? Shirou saved your life, but you're just gonna run back to the castle without an ounce of gratitude.

findings.description: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.
findings.sourceReading: Rin falsely paraphrases Illya as refusing the house because Emiya himself is not dependable, preferring her secure castle.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.

contexts.english: "You're saying it right now. You don't want to go to Emiya's house because you don't want to rely on him, right? You'd feel better back at your own castle."

findings.description: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.

findings.explanation: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃ、わたしも行くね。遠坂の師の遺産になんて興味はないけど、魔法使いの使ってた宝箱はキレイそうだし」
contexts.english: "Then I should come, too. I'm not interested in Kischur's relics, but Zel Schweinorg sounds pretty nice."

findings.description: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.
findings.sourceReading: Illya grants Sakura the supposed exception of being treated as human because she knows Shirou.
findings.explanation: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.

contexts.english: "Hi, Sakura. I heard you're a daughter of the Makiris, but I won't hold that against you. You seem like you know Shirou, so I'll give you special treatment."

findings.description: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
contexts.english: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.

findings.description: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.

findings.explanation: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ、桜とは初対面のくせになんであんなにつっかかるんだろう。やっぱりアインツベルンとマキリって仲が悪いのかな」

findings.description: Practice in darkness becomes blindfolded training.

findings.explanation: Practice in darkness becomes blindfolded training.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は冬木市一帯が停電の為、闇稽古とあいなりました。
contexts.english: Due to the blackout across Fuyuki City, tonight will be blindfolded training.

findings.description: “Lady” removes the familiar older-sister address from the strange voice’s reply. The abnormal delivery remains, but the childlike familiarity changes.

findings.explanation: “Lady” removes the familiar older-sister address from the strange voice’s reply. The abnormal delivery remains, but the childlike familiarity changes.

contexts.japanese: —ウン、ソウダヨオネエチャン。
contexts.english: YEAH, LADY. IT'S ME.

findings.explanation: Honoring Archer's words at the relevant choice becomes doing whatever Archer says.

contexts.english: Shirou, go back to the last decision and do what Archer says!

findings.explanation: Shirou not believing appearance is his reason becomes not being influenced on purpose.

contexts.english: It's not like I'm doing it on purpose, but maybe what she looks like is getting to me.

findings.explanation: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.

contexts.english: Illya fumes at Sakura as she stomps over to the shed.

findings.explanation: Sakura's ongoing recovery becomes completed restoration.

contexts.english: Nobody will like you if you're so stingy at such a young age."

findings.explanation: People Illya likes become a singular person she likes.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。あとはゆっくり休むだけだね、シロウ」
contexts.english: "Yeah. You just need to rest now, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Immediate-return plan retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He plans a short clothing change and a talk upon returning.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate-return plan retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ん—そうだな、休まないとな。ちょっと部屋で着替えてくる。話があるから、イリヤはもうちょっと起きててくれ。すぐ戻る」
contexts.english: "Mm. Yeah, I should get some rest. I'm going to go change in my room. I want to talk to you about something, so wait here a little longer. I'll be right back."

counterexamples.description: Rin’s earlier arrival and briefing retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She arrived an hour earlier and heard the forest events from Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s earlier arrival and briefing retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ほんの一時間前よ。森で何が起きたのかはイリヤから聞いたわ」
contexts.english: "Just an hour ago. Illya told me what happened in the forest."

counterexamples.description: Rin challenges Illya’s urgent excuse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies dependence on Sakura and asks for the truth.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin challenges Illya’s urgent excuse.

contexts.japanese: 「どうだか。今の言い訳じゃ桜次第ってコトでしょ。イリヤ、本当のところはどうなのよ」
contexts.english: "Oh, really? Those excuses all depend on Sakura. How about the truth, Illya?"

counterexamples.description: Illya admits more time and Sakura’s strength.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She concedes roughly a day before self-loss and puppetry because Sakura is strong-willed.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya admits more time and Sakura’s strength.

contexts.japanese: ええ、ホントはもうちょっと猶予があったかな。サクラは芯が強いから簡単に壊れたりしない。サクラが自我をなくしてゾウケンの操り人形になるまで、あと一日は間があったでしょうね」
contexts.english: Yeah, I think I still had a bit more time. Sakura is strong-willed, so she won't break that easily. I would have given it one more day until she lost her mind and became Zouken's puppet."

counterexamples.description: Friendly banter triggers renewed lapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Relaxation from the exchange threatens concentration.
counterexamples.explanation: Friendly banter triggers renewed lapse.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とイリヤの掛け合いで、緊張感が薄れてしまったようだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka and Illya's banter threatened to relax my tension.

counterexamples.description: Illya obtained needed information from Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her knowledge is attributed to extracting information from Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya obtained needed information from Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。サクラから必要な情報を取り出して、何が起きているのかは理解できた。
contexts.english: "Yes. I understood what was happening when I extracted necessary information from Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Resignation remains narrator’s uncertain reading.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tentatively interprets her closing eyes as resignation.
counterexamples.explanation: Resignation remains narrator’s uncertain reading.

contexts.japanese: ……あれは諦め、だろうか。
contexts.english: ...In resignation, I think.

counterexamples.description: Illya’s altered hollow calm retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration marks a current unusual calm and emptiness like another person.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya’s altered hollow calm retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のイリヤは、どこか別人のような静けさと空虚さを持っていた。
contexts.english: Right now, Illya's displaying a hollow calm that makes her seem like a different person.

counterexamples.description: Local ritual two hundred years versus earlier wandering retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The search predates the ritual’s establishment here.
counterexamples.explanation: Local ritual two hundred years versus earlier wandering retained.

contexts.japanese: いえ、聖杯を求める彼らの放浪はもっと前から続いていたけど、この土地での儀式が始まったのは二百年前からだった」
contexts.english: No, their journey in search of the Holy Grail had been going on for some time before that, but the ritual was established in this land two hundred years ago."

counterexamples.description: Servant combat exposed as redundant procedure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Actual order of purpose is reversed and fighting is not inherently required.
counterexamples.explanation: Servant combat exposed as redundant procedure.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。じゃあ順番が逆、という事はもう説明しなくていい？　シロウはどう？　本当はサーヴァント同士に戦わせる、なんて過程そのものが余分なんだって気付いてた？」
contexts.english: "I see. Then I don't need to explain that the reality is the other way around, right? What about you, Shirou? Did you notice that the entire premise of having Servants fight each other is unnecessary?"

counterexamples.description: Receptor ruby and post-summoning expendability retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters serve as summoning receptors and are expendable afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Receptor ruby and post-summoning expendability retained.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。聖杯戦争という儀式において、マスターはサーヴァントをこの世に呼び出す受容体にすぎない。サーヴァントさえ召喚してくれれば、後はマスターなんていつ死んでもらっても構わないのよ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. In the Holy Grail War ritual, Masters are nothing but receptors for the Servants. As long as they can summon the Servants, it doesn't matter if they all die afterward.

counterexamples.description: Spirits’ outside-time power retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Souls external to the time axis and local laws can still affect the world.
counterexamples.explanation: Spirits’ outside-time power retained.

contexts.japanese: 時間軸の外にいる純粋な『魂』、この世の道理から外れ、なおこの世に干渉できる外界の力—それが英霊の本質でしょう」
contexts.english: They are pure souls which exist outside the time axis, separate from the world's laws, yet have power from outside the world which allows them to interfere with our world. That is the true essence of Heroic Spirits."

counterexamples.description: True immortality as lost Einzbern Mystic retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A lost ritual would achieve genuine immortality for ordinary souls.
counterexamples.explanation: True immortality as lost Einzbern Mystic retained.

contexts.japanese: 「それはアインツベルンから失われたとされる神秘、真の不老不死を実現させる大儀礼。
contexts.english: "It's a Mystic believed lost to us Einzberns. A grand ritual to achieve true immortality.

counterexamples.description: Partial Third Magic versus evocation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Summoning uses part of Third Magic, but Heroic Spirits are still evocations.
counterexamples.explanation: Partial Third Magic versus evocation retained.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。たしかに英霊召喚の基盤は第三魔法の一部を使っているけど、英霊はあくまで降霊でしょう。
contexts.english: "They aren't. It's true that the foundation of Heroic Spirit summoning uses a portion of the Third Magic, but Heroic Spirits are ultimately evocations.

counterexamples.description: Living souls and next stage retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The soul itself becomes a living entity advancing as life.
counterexamples.explanation: Living souls and next stage retained.

contexts.japanese: 魂そのものを生き物にして、生命体として次のステップに向かうものを言うのよ」
contexts.english: I'm talking about turning souls themselves into living beings and advancing them to the next stage of life."

counterexamples.description: Hole must be made where no path exists.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They break the wall because the land cannot naturally reach the Root.
counterexamples.explanation: Hole must be made where no path exists.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ、届くほど歪んではいない。だから穴を開けるのよ。道が繋がっていないなら、自分たちで壁を壊すしかないでしょう？」
contexts.english: "Yes. This place isn't distorted enough to reach it. So a hole is opened instead. If there's no road connecting to the Root, then you just need to break the walls down, right?"

counterexamples.description: Hidden large storage circle retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzberns need a large energy-storing circle out of Association sight.
counterexamples.explanation: Hidden large storage circle retained.

contexts.japanese: 「アインツベルンが必要としたのは、魔術協会の目につかず、大量の魔力を貯蔵できる巨大な魔法陣だけ。
contexts.english: "All the Einzberns needed was a giant magic circle that could store a large amount of magical energy away from the prying eyes of the Mage's Association.

counterexamples.description: Lesser Grail as supplied key retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern-provided key is distinguished from the land-based Greater circle.
counterexamples.explanation: Lesser Grail as supplied key retained.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンが毎回鍵として用意するものを聖杯と呼ぶ」
contexts.english: while the key that the Einzberns supply each time is the Lesser Grail."

counterexamples.description: Lesser soul core powers Greater system retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Greater manages system; Lesser collects defeated souls and supplies the operating core.
counterexamples.explanation: Lesser soul core powers Greater system retained.

contexts.japanese: 「大聖杯は聖杯戦争のシステムを管理するもので、聖杯は敗れていった英霊の魂を回収し、大聖杯を動かす為の炉心にあたるわ」
contexts.english: "The Greater Grail manages the Holy Grail War system, while the Lesser Grail collects the souls of defeated Heroic Spirits and serves as a core to power the Greater Grail."

counterexamples.description: Opening only first step retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hole does not yet provide the desired Root result.
counterexamples.explanation: Opening only first step retained.

contexts.japanese: 「もちろん、こんなのは初めの一歩。穴を開けられたところで望みのものは手に入らない。根源への道は遠すぎる」
contexts.english: "Of course, that's just the first step. They can't obtain what they want just because they made an opening. The path to the Root is too long."

counterexamples.description: Gradual local mana collection avoids exhaustion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Greater Grail absorbs land’s mana slowly over fifty years without drying it out.
counterexamples.explanation: Gradual local mana collection avoids exhaustion.

contexts.japanese: 大聖杯は五十年かけて、この土地に満ちる魔力を枯らさないよう少しずつ吸い上げ、それが溜まった時—」
contexts.english: The Greater Grail takes fifty years to collect this land's mana without sucking it dry, and once it has enough..."

counterexamples.description: False contest deceives both Masters and Servants.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Outward rules conceal purpose and sustain mutual slaughter.
counterexamples.explanation: False contest deceives both Masters and Servants.

contexts.japanese: それを隠す為に聖杯戦争なんて表向きのルールを作って、サーヴァントとマスターを騙して、今まで殺し合いを続けさせた」
contexts.english: So, they came up with the Holy Grail War scheme to trick Servants and Masters into killing each other. It is a scheme that continues to this day."

counterexamples.description: Founders’ convenient elimination of collaborators retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Formal competition legally disposes of outsiders.
counterexamples.explanation: Founders’ convenient elimination of collaborators retained.

contexts.japanese: 三家にとってみれば、自分たち以外の協力者を合法的に始末できるんだから、都合が良かったのよ」
contexts.english: From the perspective of the founding families, it was a legal and convenient way to eliminate the other collaborators."

counterexamples.description: Kotomine’s contamination parallels Sakura’s.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both received Avenger’s taint.
counterexamples.explanation: Kotomine’s contamination parallels Sakura’s.

contexts.japanese: あいつもサクラと同じ、復讐者に汚染された魔術師だもの。聖杯の中にいるモノがなんであるか、とっくの昔に知っていたんだ」
contexts.english: He's a mage who was tainted by Avenger, like Sakura. He's probably known all along what was inside the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Becoming living form framed as ongoing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Avenger is on its way toward a successful Third Magic case.
counterexamples.explanation: Becoming living form framed as ongoing.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の力で『生命』としてカタチを得ようとしている、第三魔法の成功例になりつつある英霊よ」
contexts.english: It's a Heroic Spirit that's on its way to becoming a successful case of the Third Magic, using the power of the Grail to acquire a shape as a living creature."

counterexamples.description: Innate attributes limit the Grail success claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Avenger’s materialization rests on its own preexisting attributes.
counterexamples.explanation: Innate attributes limit the Grail success claim.

contexts.japanese: 「いいえ、復讐者の物質化は、聖杯による魔法じゃない。アレはもとからそういう属性をもった英霊だった。
contexts.english: "No, Avenger's materialization doesn't use the Magic of the Holy Grail. It's a Heroic Spirit who's always innately had those attributes.

counterexamples.description: First failure and early second defeat motivate third gamble.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern desperation precedes summoning a killing-specialized spirit.
counterexamples.explanation: First failure and early second defeat motivate third gamble.

contexts.japanese: 一度目は失敗、二度目に序盤で敗れ去ったアインツベルンは追い詰められて、ただ殺す事だけに特化した英霊を召喚したの」
contexts.english: After failing in the first war and being eliminated early in the second, the Einzberns got desperate and summoned a Heroic Spirit specialized at killing."

counterexamples.description: Forbidden summon for monopoly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kill other Masters, force activation, and monopolize results motivate the summon.
counterexamples.explanation: Forbidden summon for monopoly retained.

contexts.japanese: 他のマスターたちを皆殺しにして、問答無用で大聖杯を起動させ、成果を独り占めする為に呼んではならないモノを呼び寄せてしまった。
contexts.english: They summoned something forbidden in order to kill all the other Masters, force the Greater Grail to activate, and monopolize the spoils.

counterexamples.description: Nameless human versus literal devil retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A title-bearing hero existed without being a literal devil in life.
counterexamples.explanation: Nameless human versus literal devil retained.

contexts.japanese: ……彼は確かに無名であったし、真実悪魔などではなかった。けれど、アンリマユの名を冠した英雄は確かに存在したの」
contexts.english: ...It's true he was nameless and not a literal devil. But a hero bearing the title of Aŋra Mainiiu definitely existed."

counterexamples.description: Genuine world-peace wish retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Village sincerely sought universal peace.
counterexamples.explanation: Genuine world-peace wish retained.

contexts.japanese: その村落の人たちはね、本気で世界中みんなが平和である事を望んでいた。
contexts.english: The people of that village genuinely wished for world peace.

counterexamples.description: Scapegoat logic explicitly a childish belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They sincerely believed concentrating evil in one person would absolve others.
counterexamples.explanation: Scapegoat logic explicitly a childish belief.

contexts.japanese: そんな子供みたいに単純なコトを、彼らは本気で信じてしまった」
contexts.english: They sincerely believed that simple, childish idea."

counterexamples.description: Captured body inscribed with curses retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Village selects and physically marks a victim and assigns evil deeds to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Captured body inscribed with curses retained.

contexts.japanese: 彼らは青年を捕らえ、その全身に人を呪うあらゆる言葉を刻み、彼らが知り得る全ての罪業を与え、全ての悪事を彼の責任とした。
contexts.english: They captured him and carved all manner of curses into his body. They charged him with every crime known to man, and blamed him for all evil deeds.

counterexamples.description: Killing corrected to denial of death retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya corrects killed until broken to never allowed merciful death until lifespan ended.
counterexamples.explanation: Killing corrected to denial of death retained.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の人々の善性を証明する為に、一人の青年を崩壊するまで殺し続けた。いえ、その寿命がつきるまで殺してなどあげなかった」
contexts.english: To prove the goodness of all the people in the world, they killed a young man until he broke. No, they refused to put him out of his misery until his life ran out."

counterexamples.description: Hatred and reverence coexist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They curse, fear, and revere the scapegoat simultaneously.
counterexamples.explanation: Hatred and reverence coexist.

contexts.japanese: 「彼らは彼を心底呪い、侮蔑し、恐れ、同時に奉った。
contexts.english: "They cursed, scorned, and feared him, all while revering him.

counterexamples.description: Actual demon transformation left unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya does not know if the process literally made him a demon.
counterexamples.explanation: Actual demon transformation left unknown.

contexts.japanese: 「その過程で、青年が本当に悪魔になったかどうかは知らない。
contexts.english: "I don't know if their process turned him into an actual demon.

counterexamples.description: His role supplies justification for their wrongdoing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His existence functions as an indulgence whatever evils they commit.
counterexamples.explanation: His role supplies justification for their wrongdoing.

contexts.japanese: その存在が在るだけで、どんなに人々が悪事を重ねようとも『清く正しい』と赦される免罪符。
contexts.english: His existence alone was a justification for other people to be forgiven, no matter what evils they committed.

counterexamples.description: Neither irony nor disdain retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya’s calm report lacks mockery or contempt.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither irony nor disdain retained.

contexts.japanese: 皮肉も侮蔑も込めず、イリヤは淡々と大昔の出来事を語り終えた。
contexts.english: Illya cooly describes an ancient event, with neither irony nor disdain.

counterexamples.description: Summoned spirit incredibly weak retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Original summoned Avenger is weak despite demon title.
counterexamples.explanation: Summoned spirit incredibly weak retained.

contexts.japanese: けど呼び出された英霊は、すごく弱かった。
contexts.english: But the Heroic Spirit they got was incredibly weak.

counterexamples.description: No own power and surrounding wishes retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Impossible spirit originates in others’ feelings, not intrinsic strength.
counterexamples.explanation: No own power and surrounding wishes retained.

contexts.japanese: ……もとから何の力も無く、周りの人間の想いだけで構成された、有り得ない筈のモノ。
contexts.english: ...He never had any power of his own. He was an impossibility created by the feelings of those around him.

counterexamples.description: Others’ wishes survive personality loss.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He was made hero by those around him and remains wished evil without personality.
counterexamples.explanation: Others’ wishes survive personality loss.

contexts.japanese: けどアンリマユは違った。彼は自分ではなく周りが願って創り上げた英雄。人格などなくとも、アンリマユである以上、悪であれと望まれる存在だった」
contexts.english: But Aŋra Mainiiu was different. He didn't become a hero on his own, but was made into one by the wishes of people around him. He was an existence which people wished to be evil, regardless of his own personality."

counterexamples.description: Absorption accepts a wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The Grail treats the absorbed wish-being as a wish to grant.
counterexamples.explanation: Absorption accepts a wish.

contexts.japanese: だから—アンリマユが聖杯に取り込まれた瞬間、聖杯は一つの願いを受諾してしまったの」
contexts.english: And that's why, the moment the Holy Grail absorbed Aŋra Mainiiu, it accepted a wish."

counterexamples.description: Five hundred and one thousand years comparison retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Makiri and Einzbern projects are contrasted with the older human ideal.
counterexamples.explanation: Five hundred and one thousand years comparison retained.

contexts.japanese: ……マキリの五百年、アインツベルンの一千年なんて子供だましよ。
contexts.english: ...The five centuries of the Makiris and the thousand years of the Einzberns are child's play,

counterexamples.description: Neutral Servant power feeds evil shell.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Other souls supply the energy for the shell to take form.
counterexamples.explanation: Neutral Servant power feeds evil shell.

contexts.japanese: アンリマユはサーヴァントたちの無色の魔力を糧に、自分の霊殻である“この世全ての悪”を体現してしまった。
contexts.english: Aŋra Mainiiu fed on the Servants' colorless power to manifest its shell, All the Evil in the World.

counterexamples.description: Gradual six-billion-curse capacity retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The developed Servant has the ability to curse the stated population.
counterexamples.explanation: Gradual six-billion-curse capacity retained.

contexts.japanese: 六十億の人間全てを呪う、六十億の人間全てを呪える宝具を備えたサーヴァントとして、少しずつ育っていったの」
contexts.english: He has gradually developed as a Servant who would curse six billion people, who possesses the ability to curse six billion people."

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu’s knowledge remains unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya cannot say how much he understood Avenger.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu’s knowledge remains unknown.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。キリツグがアンリマユというサーヴァントをどこまで理解していたかは判らない。
contexts.english: "Yes. I don't know how much Kiritsugu knew about the Servant Aŋra Mainiiu.

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu destroys Lesser Grail to stop emergence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Threatened Shadow exit motivates destruction of the vessel.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu destroys Lesser Grail to stop emergence.

contexts.japanese: けどキリツグは聖杯の外に出ようとしていた“黒い影”を危険視して、聖杯を破壊した」
contexts.english: But Kiritsugu saw the Shadow attempting to escape the Holy Grail as a threat, and destroyed the Lesser Grail."

counterexamples.description: Prevented birth leaves Avenger in Greater Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kiritsugu’s decision interrupted emergence but did not erase the underlying entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Prevented birth leaves Avenger in Greater Grail.

contexts.japanese: 「けど、そのアンリマユはキリツグの英断で出産には至らず、大聖杯の中に残された。
contexts.english: "Still, Kiritsugu's decision prevented Aŋra Mainiiu's birth and left it inside the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken made her Master to command the Servant when it emerges.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にいるサーヴァントが外に出てきた時、それを従えられるようサクラをマスターにしたのよ」
contexts.english: He made Sakura a Master so that she could control it if it ever emerged from the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Zouken wants linked body rather than Sakura’s self.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Personality is expendable; her body’s connection matters.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken wants linked body rather than Sakura’s self.

contexts.japanese: 「それでいいのよ。ゾウケンはサクラの人格なんて考えていないもの。ゾウケンにとって大切なのは、アンリマユと繋がっているサクラの体よ」
contexts.english: "That's the point. Zouken doesn't care about Sakura's personality. He values her body which is connected to Aŋra Mainiiu."

counterexamples.description: Soul-containing core worm enables body takeover.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His life extension depends on occupying bodies through that core.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul-containing core worm enables body takeover.

contexts.japanese: ……リンは知らないだろうけど、ゾウケンは自分の魂の容れ物である本体があれば、どんな人間の体だろうと自分のものにできる。いいえ、あいつはそうやって今まで生き長らえてきた。
contexts.english: ...You probably don't know that the core worm containing Zouken's soul can turn any human body into his own. That's how he's lived this long.

counterexamples.description: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends Illya to fulfill the Grail function while taking Sakura’s Master body.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯としての役割はわたしにやらせて、自分はアンリマユのマスターになったサクラの体を乗っ取る」
contexts.english: He plans to make me fulfill the function of the Lesser Grail, while he takes over Sakura who's become Aŋra Mainiiu's Master."

counterexamples.description: Further Avenger takeover remains speculative analogy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken probably intends eventual materialized-soul host occupation; greed-degraded deity comparison follows.
counterexamples.explanation: Further Avenger takeover remains speculative analogy.

contexts.japanese: 「そうして—行く行くは、第三魔法の成功例、魂が物質化した架空の魔物に乗り換えるつもりなんでしょう。完全な神を、人間が自らの欲望で不完全な神に貶めるように」
contexts.english: "Then, he probably plans to take over the imaginary monster Aŋra Mainiiu once it succeeds in the Third Magic and materializes its soul. It's like a human's greed degrading a perfect god into an imperfect one."

counterexamples.description: Cavern beneath Ryudou Temple retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Founding families selected this underground site two hundred years earlier.
counterexamples.explanation: Cavern beneath Ryudou Temple retained.

contexts.japanese: 堕ちた霊脈。二百年前、三家によって選ばれた始まりの土地—柳洞寺の地下に広がる大空洞に、アンリマユは受胎している」
contexts.english: The sunken ley lines. Two hundred years ago, the three families chose the cavern beneath Ryudou Temple to begin their work. That's where Aŋra Mainiiu is being conceived."

counterexamples.description: Both reasons Illya stays retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken targets her and Shirou also wants her to remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Both reasons Illya stays retained.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯がイリヤを狙っている、という事もあるが、イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望でもあるからだ。
contexts.english: It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

counterexamples.description: Previous castle not reached.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Earlier route ended at meeting Illya fleeing the Shadow before the castle.
counterexamples.explanation: Previous castle not reached.

contexts.japanese: ……以前ここに来た時は、城には辿り着けなかった。
contexts.english: ...I couldn't reach it the last time I was here.

counterexamples.description: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy seeks Illya back without Sakura noticing.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.

contexts.japanese: 桜に気付かれず、イリヤを連れ戻す。
contexts.english: I need to retrieve Illya without Sakura noticing me.

counterexamples.description: Illya rescue buys preparation time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest limits present objective and postpones Sakura confrontation until resistance is prepared.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rescue buys preparation time.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

counterexamples.description: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy will prevent Illya's death and Sakura's killing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.

contexts.japanese: ……イリヤは殺させないし、桜にそんな事はさせない。
contexts.english: I won't let Illya die, and I won't let Sakura kill her.

counterexamples.description: Alliance expires after rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They return to enemy status once Illya is rescued.
counterexamples.explanation: Alliance expires after rescue.

contexts.japanese: 「言っただろう。イリヤスフィールを助け出した後は敵同士だと。私の目的はおまえたちとは違う。
contexts.english: "I told you, we will be enemies once Illyasviel is rescued. My goals are different than yours.

counterexamples.description: Help recognized without accepting ideology.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest really seeks Illya's rescue and Sakura's freedom from Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Help recognized without accepting ideology.

contexts.japanese: が—イリヤを助けようとし、臓硯から桜を解放させようとしているのは本当だった。
contexts.english: Still, it's true that he's helping me rescue Illya, and that he's trying to set Sakura free from Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Best ally for current operation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels he has the strongest available ally now and must still rescue and escape.
counterexamples.explanation: Best ally for current operation.

contexts.japanese: この場において何よりも勝る味方を得た。
contexts.english: I've gained the best ally I could ask for right now.

counterexamples.description: Intruders detected after leaving building.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Enemy already outside when Assassin reacts.
counterexamples.explanation: Intruders detected after leaving building.

contexts.japanese: 既に敵は外へ。
contexts.english: The enemy has already left the building.

counterexamples.description: Recapture pressure framed as rescue necessity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells Sakura she cannot be saved without Illya and encourages crushing pursuit.
counterexamples.explanation: Recapture pressure framed as rescue necessity.

contexts.japanese: —出番だぞ桜。イリヤスフィールなくしておまえが救われる事はない。その苦しみから逃れたいのであれば、遠慮せず蹂躙してくるがよい」
contexts.english: ...Time to go to work, Sakura. You cannot be saved without Illyasviel. If you want to be free of your pain, then crush them all."

counterexamples.description: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not told Rin he already released the shroud.
counterexamples.explanation: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤ、遠坂には聖骸布を解いた事を言っていないんだ。
contexts.english: Illya hasn't told Tohsaka that I took off the holy shroud.

counterexamples.description: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If all goes well original cannot be exactly copied but roughly half ability expected.
counterexamples.explanation: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

counterexamples.description: Projection still needs time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even boy will take time and must begin to meet midnight.
counterexamples.explanation: Projection still needs time.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ、そろそろ始めましょう。いくらシロウでもその剣の投影には時間がかかるわ。すぐに始めないと日付が変わる」
contexts.english: "Let's get started, Shirou. It'll take time to Project that sword, even for you. It'll be midnight if we don't start soon."

counterexamples.description: Private Projection request retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants only Illya with him and asks Rin to wait.
counterexamples.explanation: Private Projection request retained.

contexts.japanese: それと、投影中はイリヤと二人きりになりたいんで、遠坂は部屋で待っててくれ」
contexts.english: I want to be alone with Illya while I do the Projection, so go wait in your room, Tohsaka."

counterexamples.description: Rin compromises by waiting outside.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accepts staying beyond shed door.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin compromises by waiting outside.

contexts.japanese: 「……わかったわ、わたしは蔵の外で待機してる。それでいいんでしょ、イリヤ」
contexts.english: "...All right. I'll wait outside the shed. That's fine, right?"

counterexamples.description: Screaming example is a conditional joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She promises not to enter even if he screams.
counterexamples.explanation: Screaming example is a conditional joke.

contexts.japanese: 「しつこいわね。分かったって言ったでしょ、たとえ士郎の悲鳴があがっても中には入らないわよ」
contexts.english: "Persistent, aren't you? I said I get it. I won't go in even if Shirou screams."

counterexamples.description: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not seen sword herself but contains its record.
counterexamples.explanation: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.

contexts.japanese: 「分かってるわ。シロウにはまず、わたしの記録に入ってもらう。わたしだって見た事はないけど、わたしの中には宝石剣の記録があるわ。
contexts.english: "I know. I'm going to have you search the records inside me. I haven't personally seen it, but there's a record of the Jeweled Sword inside my mind.

counterexamples.description: Sight and consciousness move into record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body stays while consciousness and eyes enter Illya's record to analyze sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Sight and consciousness move into record.

contexts.japanese: 「いいから目を閉じて。シロウの体はそのままで、意識だけを別の場所に移すわ。前もやったでしょ？　シロウの眼をわたしの記録に移すから、そこで宝石剣を解析して。
contexts.english: "Just close your eyes. Stay still. I'm going to send your consciousness somewhere else. I did it before, remember? I'll send your sight inside me, where you can analyze the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Binding released after entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya unbinds left arm once he is inside and demands quick Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Binding released after entry.

contexts.japanese: ……シロウが中に入ったら、わたしが左腕の拘束を外す。二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力と、左腕の侵食が同時に来るわ。気をしっかり持って、出来るだけ早く投影を終わらせなさい」
contexts.english: ...Once you're inside, I'll unbind your left arm. Your arm is going to invade you at the same time while you travel two hundred years into history. Keep a firm grip on yourself and try to finish the Projection as quickly as you can."

counterexamples.description: Instruction coexists with visible fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her voice and embrace tremble.
counterexamples.explanation: Instruction coexists with visible fear.

contexts.japanese: ……俺を正面から抱いたイリヤの腕も、小刻みに震えている。
contexts.english: ...I can feel her arms trembling as she hugs me from the front, too.

counterexamples.description: Do not look at unnecessary things.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She guides him to sword and tells him to exclude distraction.
counterexamples.explanation: Do not look at unnecessary things.

contexts.japanese: 「……宝石剣まではわたしが連れて行くから、シロウは息を止めているだけでいい。雑念は捨てて。余計なものは見ないで。シロウはわたしの中から、彼のゼルレッチを抜き取ってくるだけでいい—」
contexts.english: "...I'll take you until we find the Jeweled Sword so you just need to still your breathing. Don't get distracted. Don't look at anything you don't have to. You just need to draw out the Zelretch."

counterexamples.description: Illya calls for return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She demands stop and return while he continues.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya calls for return.

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでよ！　戻りなさいシロウ……！」
contexts.english: "That's enough! Come back, Shirou!"

counterexamples.description: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks whether he wants to fade away.
counterexamples.explanation: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「諦めなさい……！　このまま消え去りたいのシロウ！」
contexts.english: "Give up! Do you want to fade away, Shirou!?"

counterexamples.description: Knife perception is delirious.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragmented boy feels a huge kitchen-knife stab before recognizing Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Knife perception is delirious.

contexts.japanese: 横合いからでっかい包丁で刺された。
contexts.english: A huge kitchen knife stabs me in the side.

counterexamples.description: Illya not injured.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy confirms she is fortunately unhurt after striking her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya not injured.

contexts.japanese: ……良かった。幸い、イリヤに怪我はない。
contexts.english: ...Thank goodness. Luckily, I didn't injure her.

counterexamples.description: Disobedient looking rebuked.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She repeats not to look at unnecessary things and forgives because result succeeded.
counterexamples.explanation: Disobedient looking rebuked.

contexts.japanese: 「バカ、余計なものは見るなって言ったじゃないっ……！
contexts.english: "You idiot! I told you not to look at anything unnecessary!

counterexamples.description: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya specifically praises Projection and swordmaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.

contexts.japanese: 「そ。小言はいっぱいあるけど、とりあえずお疲れさまシロウ。投影だけなら完璧、非の打ち所のない剣製を見せてもらったわ」
contexts.english: "I have a lot to scold you about, but good work, Shirou. That was a perfect Projection. A flawless display of sword creation."

counterexamples.description: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon's exceptional usability restriction explains boy's impression.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.

contexts.japanese: 「それはそれでいいのよ。その剣はシュバインオーグの系譜の者にしか扱えない、とびっきりの魔剣なんだから。
contexts.english: "It's good enough. Only the Schweinorg lineage can use that sword. It's a magical sword unlike any other.

counterexamples.description: Third/Second distinction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura receives Third's blessing while young Rin seeks to wield Second.
counterexamples.explanation: Third/Second distinction retained.

contexts.japanese: ま、考えてみると因果よね。サクラは第三の加護を受けて、リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しようっていうんだから。協会の連中がいたら調査どころの話じゃない、各部門あげての裁判沙汰になりかねないわ」
contexts.english: I guess you could call it fate. Sakura is blessed by the Third, while Rin's going to operate the Second at a young age. If the Association knew about this, they'd do more than just investigate. It would turn into a court battle against every single department."

counterexamples.description: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tohsakas received design alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.

contexts.japanese: 「と言っても、遠坂に継承されたのは設計図だけで宝石剣そのものじゃないわ。
contexts.english: "Still, the Tohsakas only inherited the blueprints, not the Jeweled Sword itself.

counterexamples.description: Return of master only possible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zelretch seems absent from this world and might visit after Rin's achievement.
counterexamples.explanation: Return of master only possible.

contexts.japanese: ゼルレッチ本人はこの世界にはいないようだけど、リンが自分の手で宝石剣を作れるようになったらひょっこりやってくるかもしれない」
contexts.english: I think Zelretch isn't in this world at the moment, but he might pop in for a visit once he hears that Rin managed to make the Jeweled Sword herself."

counterexamples.description: Private conversation undisclosed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin takes Illya away and she silently follows.
counterexamples.explanation: Private conversation undisclosed.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂はイリヤを連れて行き、イリヤも黙ったままついて行く。
contexts.english: She goes off with Illya, who also doesn't say a word.

counterexamples.description: Illya remains for two reasons.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken targeting her and boy's own wish both explain staying.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya remains for two reasons.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯がイリヤを狙っている、という事もあるが、イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望でもあるからだ。
contexts.english: It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

counterexamples.description: Apprentice asks for rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She demands hurry and save her.
counterexamples.explanation: Apprentice asks for rescue.

contexts.japanese: さっさとわたしを助けにこーい！
contexts.english: Go save me right now!

counterexamples.description: Four remaining Dojos is in-work count.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dialogue says four Dojos remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Four remaining Dojos is in-work count.

contexts.japanese: 残るタイガー道場もあと四つ。
contexts.english: There are four Tiger Dojos left.

counterexamples.description: Disciple praise intact on held unit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Teacher praises Disciple One.
counterexamples.explanation: Disciple praise intact on held unit.

contexts.japanese: うむ、よく言った弟子一号！
contexts.english: Well said, Disciple Number One!

counterexamples.description: Cut-route resource banter remains metatext.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Finite budget/schedule excuse responds to desired rejected routes.
counterexamples.explanation: Cut-route resource banter remains metatext.

contexts.japanese: キー！　没ルートの話は言うな！　資源と時間は無限ではないっ！
contexts.english: Eeek! Stop talking about deleted routes! We don't have an unlimited budget or schedule!

counterexamples.description: Speaker name forgotten.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears voice without remembering name.
counterexamples.explanation: Speaker name forgotten.

contexts.japanese: もう名前も思い出せない、誰かの声。
contexts.english: Someone's voice. I can't remember her name.

counterexamples.description: Not returning feared.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Without stopping her he thinks she will never come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Not returning feared.

contexts.japanese: —そうしなければ、—は、二度と帰ってこないと。
contexts.english: If I don't, — will never come home.

counterexamples.description: Wants live and stop her simultaneously.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants life but must recover name and stop sacrifice.
counterexamples.explanation: Wants live and stop her simultaneously.

contexts.japanese: 生きたい。名前を。名前を呼んで、止めさせないと。
contexts.english: I want to live. What's her name? I have to say her name and stop her.

counterexamples.description: Desire persists despite understood cost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows affirmative answer makes her disappear yet wishes to live wholeheartedly.
counterexamples.explanation: Desire persists despite understood cost.

contexts.japanese: でも生きたい。そう頷いたら—が消えてしまうと判っているのに、名前を、生きたいと、心の底から、生きたいと願っていた。
contexts.english: But I want to live. I know — will disappear if I nod, what's her name, I wish from the bottom of my heart to live.

counterexamples.description: Magecraft and Magic distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is Magic everyone wished to see.
counterexamples.explanation: Magecraft and Magic distinguished.

contexts.japanese: なんていったって、みんなが見たがってた魔法なんだから。
contexts.english: This is the Magic everyone wishes they could see.

counterexamples.description: Miracle refused as sacrifice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says no need show it, come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Miracle refused as sacrifice.

contexts.japanese: いい。そんなの見なくていい。いいから戻ってきてくれ。
contexts.english: Don't do it. You don't have to show me. Just come back.

counterexamples.description: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only her body can be used; imperfect result expected fixable with Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.

contexts.japanese: 使えるのはわたしの体しかないから、完全に再現はできないの。けどだいじょうぶ。リンといっしょに試行錯誤すれば、すぐに元通りにしてもらえるわ。
contexts.english: We only have my body to use, so I can't completely recreate it. It'll be okay, though. If you do some trial and error with Rin, I'm sure you can go back to normal.

counterexamples.description: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: White figure becomes sacrificial key and closes Greater Grail like first rite.
counterexamples.explanation: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.

contexts.japanese: 白い装束の誰かは、初めの儀式のように、起動のための生贄になって、大聖杯を閉ざしていく。
contexts.english: Someone in a white dress becomes a sacrificial key and closes the Greater Grail, just like the very first ritual.

counterexamples.description: No blood relation explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She and Shirou not blood related.
counterexamples.explanation: No blood relation explicit.

contexts.japanese: わたしとシロウは血が繋がっていないけど。
contexts.english: We aren't related by blood,

counterexamples.description: Cannot sacrifice and promised togetherness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot sacrifice her and recalls promised shared life to make up loneliness.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot sacrifice and promised togetherness.

contexts.japanese: 犠牲にできない。一緒に暮らすって言った。今まで一人にした分、一緒に暮らすって言っただろう。
contexts.english: I can't sacrifice you. I said we'd live together, that I'd make up for all the time you spent alone.

counterexamples.description: Big-sister reversal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is older sister so must protect little brother.
counterexamples.explanation: Big-sister reversal retained.

contexts.japanese: ……ええ。わたしはお姉ちゃんだもん。なら、弟を守らなくっちゃ。
contexts.english: ...Yeah. Well, I'm your big sister. So I have to protect my little brother.

counterexamples.description: Actual relative age retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Silver-haired red-eyed girl slightly older than him.
counterexamples.explanation: Actual relative age retained.

contexts.japanese: 俺より少しだけ年上の、銀の髪と赤い目をした—
contexts.english: She's a girl with red eyes and silver hair, a little older than me—

counterexamples.description: Recovered name repeated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He repeatedly calls Illya after remembering.
counterexamples.explanation: Recovered name repeated.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ—イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ—！！！」
contexts.english: "Illya... Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya!!!"

counterexamples.description: Smiling farewell and closed gate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says goodbye, smiles and closes Grail gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Smiling farewell and closed gate.

contexts.japanese: じゃあねと微笑って、パタン、と大聖杯の門を閉めた。
contexts.english: She said goodbye, smiled, and shut the door to the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: Saved life still sinks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Life Illya saved is sinking.
counterexamples.explanation: Saved life still sinks.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

counterexamples.description: Earlier record lacked entity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya-record wasteland did not contain this thing.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier record lacked entity.

contexts.japanese: 以前、イリヤの記録にあった荒野に、あんなモノは存在しなかった。
contexts.english: That didn't exist in the wasteland I saw in Illya's record.
