counterexamples.description: Former comrade's self-sacrifice and Heaven's Cup retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two hundred years earlier she sacrificed herself to build Greater Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Former comrade's self-sacrifice and Heaven's Cup retained.

contexts.japanese: 大聖杯を築き上げる為、自ら生贄となった、天の杯であった我が同胞。
contexts.english: She was his comrade—the Cup of Heaven who sacrificed herself to build the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: Nemesis and why-question retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Comrade-memory addresses archenemy and asks original reason to avoid death.
counterexamples.explanation: Nemesis and why-question retained.

contexts.japanese: 「問おう、我が仇敵よ。汝は、なぜ死にたくないと思ったのか」
contexts.english: "Tell me, my nemesis. Why did you not want to die?"

counterexamples.description: False final dojo premise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Previous installment already called last.
counterexamples.explanation: False final dojo premise retained.

contexts.japanese: タイガー道場は前回で最終回を迎えたよ。
contexts.english: Last time was the final Tiger Dojo.

counterexamples.description: Trust Rider because boy cannot defeat Saber.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No matter what Shirou cannot beat Saber, do own job.
counterexamples.explanation: Trust Rider because boy cannot defeat Saber.

contexts.japanese: そうだよー。シロウじゃどうあってもセイバーには勝てないんだから、ここはライダーを信じて自分の仕事に徹するコト！
contexts.english: Yeah! You can't beat Saber no matter what, Shirou, so trust Rider and focus on your own job!

counterexamples.description: Illya route expectation meets Sakura rival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thought this route would be her turn, rival Sakura defeats competition.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya route expectation meets Sakura rival.

contexts.japanese: うう、そうなんすよ師しょー。このルートこそわたしの出番かと思ったら、ライバルがサクラでしょ？
contexts.english: Uuuu, yeah, Master. I thought this route would be my turn, but my rival was Sakura, you know?

counterexamples.description: No hidden side self-praise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya says only heroine without inside/outside split.
counterexamples.explanation: No hidden side self-praise retained.

contexts.japanese: シロウもかわいそう。ヒロインの中で裏表ないの、わたしだけだもの。
contexts.english: I feel bad for Shirou. I'm the only heroine who isn't two-faced.

contexts.japanese: ……いやまあ、たしかにイリヤちゃんは裏表ないけどね。
contexts.english: ...Well, it's true you don't have a hidden side.

counterexamples.description: Day14 affection repair advice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Restart from14 can fix affection.
counterexamples.explanation: Day14 affection repair advice retained.

contexts.japanese: でもぶっちゃけ、イリヤちゃん好感度は十四日目からやりなおせばなんとかなるのである！
contexts.english: But yes, if you restart from Day 14, you should be able to fix Illya's affection level!

counterexamples.description: Hint/spoiler hypocrisy retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Teacher justifies giving hints as Q&A purpose.
counterexamples.explanation: Hint/spoiler hypocrisy retained.

contexts.japanese: え？　だってここＱ＆Ａよ？　ヒントを出す事がわたしたちの存在理由よ？
contexts.english: Huh? This is a Q&A, you know. We only exist to give the player hints.

counterexamples.description: Harem-bait abruptly rejected as not lovey-dovey.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Taiga stops fantasy and protests no romance.
counterexamples.explanation: Harem-bait abruptly rejected as not lovey-dovey.

contexts.japanese: って、これのどこがラブラブエンドだーーーー！
contexts.english: Wait, what's lovey-dovey about this!?

counterexamples.description: Forty installments thanked.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thanks for staying all forty dojos.
counterexamples.explanation: Forty installments thanked.

contexts.japanese: 全四十回、飽きずに付き合ってくれてありがとうございました。
contexts.english: Thank you for sticking with us through all forty episodes.

counterexamples.description: Collect all stamps to discover reward.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Asks what happens all stamps; teacher withholds reward.
counterexamples.explanation: Collect all stamps to discover reward.

contexts.japanese: けどタイガ、このスタンプ全部集めるとどうなるの？
contexts.english: But Taiga, what happens when they collect all the stamps?

contexts.japanese: それは集めてのお楽しみ。
contexts.english: Collect them all to find out.

counterexamples.description: Full-completion meeting remains hope.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If fate permits meet after full completion.
counterexamples.explanation: Full-completion meeting remains hope.

contexts.japanese: それじゃあばいばーい！　縁があったら、フルコンプリート後にまた会おうねーーー！
contexts.english: Now, bye-bye! Hopefully we'll see you again once you 100% the game!

counterexamples.description: Separating wall remains simile.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Looks from far away as if wall between.
counterexamples.explanation: Separating wall remains simile.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠く、まるで壁があるように、離れた場所から俺を見ていた。
contexts.english: Illya's watching me from afar, as if there's a wall between us.

counterexamples.description: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy asks whether same vessel nature allows sensing condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う諦め。……同じ聖杯だからこそ、イリヤには桜がどんな状態なのか感じ取れるのか。
contexts.english: Her resignation is different than Tohsaka's. Maybe she can feel exactly what Sakura's going through, as a fellow Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Sakura went to erase herself, attributed to Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya says desired Sakura gone and departure self-erasure.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura went to erase herself, attributed to Illya.

contexts.japanese: シロウが好きだったサクラはもういないわ。サクラは自分を消すために、一人でここから出て行ったんだから」
contexts.english: The Sakura you love is gone. She went out alone to erase herself."

counterexamples.description: Each girl has another self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and Sakura each inner other unlike his known girl.
counterexamples.explanation: Each girl has another self retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……そう。けどシロウ。わたしもサクラも、自分の中にもう一つの自分を持っている。それはきっとシロウが知ってるわたしじゃないし、シロウが想ってるサクラとは違うんだよ。
contexts.english: "...I see. Shirou, Sakura and I each have another self inside us. It's a version of me that you don't know, and a version of Sakura that isn't what you think.

counterexamples.description: Full Illya motive remains unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot know how much feeling lies in question.
counterexamples.explanation: Full Illya motive remains unknown.

contexts.japanese: その問いにどれだけの想いが込められているのか、俺には知る由もない。
contexts.english: I don't know what feelings are behind that question.

counterexamples.description: Remaining Illya condition retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Illya inside, recognizes known Illya despite transformation.
counterexamples.explanation: Remaining Illya condition retained.

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

counterexamples.description: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stops caring about remote laughter, runs for Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.

contexts.japanese: 部屋に響きわたる臓硯の笑いなどどうでもいい。
contexts.english: I don't care about Zouken's cackling.

counterexamples.description: Consumption conditional on capture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Already blackened Sakura will devour Illya if caught.
counterexamples.explanation: Consumption conditional on capture.

contexts.japanese: 既に桜は黒化しておる、イリヤスフィールを捕らえれば容赦なく飲み下すぞ……！』
contexts.english: Sakura has already been Darkened. If she catches Illyasviel, she will devour her without mercy...!"

counterexamples.description: Twenty-minute full-speed return retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Home twenty minutes at full sprint.
counterexamples.explanation: Twenty-minute full-speed return retained.

contexts.japanese: 屋敷まで全力で走って二十分。
contexts.english: It takes twenty minutes to get home from the mansion at a full sprint.

counterexamples.description: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soon Sakura consumes, may miss monster birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.

contexts.japanese: 桜はじきイリヤスフィールを呑み込む。急がねば、おまえが育てた怪物の誕生に立ち会えなくなるぞ？』
contexts.english: Soon, Sakura will consume Illyasviel. You'd better hurry back, or you won't get to witness the birth of the monster you reared."

counterexamples.description: Rage wasted rescue time acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Gave in to anger wasted time, now rushes.
counterexamples.explanation: Rage wasted rescue time acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 怒りにまかせて時間を浪費してしまった。
contexts.english: I gave into my temper and wasted time.

counterexamples.description: Timeliness unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Will he arrive in time?
counterexamples.explanation: Timeliness unresolved.

contexts.japanese: —間に合うか。
contexts.english: Will I make it in time?

counterexamples.description: Ritual sites retain ordered four-stage history.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Temple, Tohsaka house, hill church, burned field; fifth first again.
counterexamples.explanation: Ritual sites retain ordered four-stage history.

contexts.japanese: 一度目は柳洞寺。
contexts.english: The first was Ryudou Temple.

contexts.japanese: 二度目は遠坂邸。
contexts.english: The second was the Tohsaka house.

contexts.japanese: 三度目は丘の教会。
contexts.english: The third was the church on the hill.

contexts.japanese: 四度目はあの焼け野原。
contexts.english: The fourth was that burned field.

contexts.japanese: となれば、今回の降霊は一度目の土地に戻る。
contexts.english: And this time, it will return to the land it first appeared in.

counterexamples.description: Future calamity contrasted with founders' wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Coming thing catastrophe remote from intended miracle.
counterexamples.explanation: Future calamity contrasted with founders' wish.

contexts.japanese: これから起きること、これから生まれるものは彼らが望んだものとはかけ離れた“災厄”である。
contexts.english: Whatever happens next, whatever will soon be born, will be a catastrophe far removed from what they desired.

counterexamples.description: Assigned opening role distinguished from closing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No one tasked her closing gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Assigned opening role distinguished from closing.

contexts.japanese: 「……放っておけばいい。わたしの役目は開ける事だもの。閉じろなんてコト、誰もわたしに言わなかった」
contexts.english: "...I should leave it alone. My job is only to open the way. No one told me to close it."

counterexamples.description: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern Grail can't affect different Makiri-opened gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.

contexts.japanese: マキリの聖杯が開いた門は、アインツベルンの聖杯では手が出せない。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail cannot interfere with the gate that the Makiri Grail has opened.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯は同じモノを開いたつもりで違うモノを開いたのだ。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou meant to open the same thing, but he opened something different.

counterexamples.description: Conditional flight not actual escape.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If boy returns timely perhaps run far together.
counterexamples.explanation: Conditional flight not actual escape.

contexts.japanese: 「—間に合うかな、シロウ。シロウが間に合うなら、一緒に、どこか遠くに逃げてもいいけど」
contexts.english: "I wonder if Shirou will make it back in time. If he does, we could run someplace far away."

counterexamples.description: Duty versus newfound desire conflict.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She torn between assigned duty and personal wanting.
counterexamples.explanation: Duty versus newfound desire conflict.

contexts.japanese: 自身に課せられた責務と、自身に生まれた欲求のどちらを選ぶべきか迷っている。
contexts.english: She's having trouble choosing between her duty, and the newfound desires in her.

counterexamples.description: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Slipped through versus not counted as intruder.
counterexamples.explanation: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮邸に張られた結界をすり抜けたのか、それとも結界は彼女を“侵入者”とみなさなかったのか。
contexts.english: Did it infiltrate the Bounded Field around the home, or did the barrier fail to identify her as an intruder?

counterexamples.description: Hand toward Illya interrupted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Reaches shoulder then Rin interrupts.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand toward Illya interrupted.

contexts.japanese: 足音も立てず、居間から中庭に移動した彼女は、中庭で佇む少女の肩に、ゆっくりと手を、
contexts.english: She moves from the living room to the backyard without making a sound, and reaches for the girl's shoulder—

counterexamples.description: Illya moves aside to observe.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unsurprised girl walks yard edge for face-off.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya moves aside to observe.

contexts.japanese: 少女は間桐桜と遠坂凛—二人の対峙を傍観するように、中庭の端まで歩いていった。
contexts.english: She goes to the edge of the yard, as if to spectate the face-off between Sakura and Rin.

counterexamples.description: Capture order permits roughness only if resistance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber ordered capture Grail, some force okay if resists.
counterexamples.explanation: Capture order permits roughness only if resistance.

contexts.japanese: 「セイバー、聖杯を捕まえて。抵抗するようなら多少の乱暴は構わないから」
contexts.english: "Saber, capture the Holy Grail. I don't mind if you get rough with it if it resists."

counterexamples.description: Acceptance and abduction orders explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken asserts only life path take Einzbern Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Acceptance and abduction orders explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—さあ、その影を受け入れるがいい。おまえを止められる者はおらぬ。アインツベルンの娘を奪い、聖杯を手に入れよ。もはや、おまえにそれ以外の生きる術はない」
contexts.english: "Now, accept your shadow. Nobody can stop you now. Seize the Einzbern girl and acquire the Holy Grail. You have no other way to survive."

counterexamples.description: Immediate danger ranking survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: None can be abandoned, but Rin is in greatest danger now.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate danger ranking survives.

contexts.japanese: —どれもが放っておけないが、今は遠坂が一番危ない。
contexts.english: I can't neglect any of them, but right now, Tohsaka's in the most danger.

counterexamples.description: Further absorption creates no-return threshold.
counterexamples.sourceReading: More intake would make return impossible.
counterexamples.explanation: Further absorption creates no-return threshold.

contexts.japanese: —貴女、これ以上取り込むと戻れなくなるから」
contexts.english: There's no going back if you swallow anything else."

counterexamples.description: Illya bargains by offering peaceful accompaniment for others' release.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies herself as target, offers go quietly, orders leave the others.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya bargains by offering peaceful accompaniment for others' release.

contexts.japanese: 「サクラはわたしが目的なんでしょ。なら早く済ませましょう。大人しく一緒にいってあげるから、あんなの放っておきなさい」
contexts.english: "You're here for me, right? Then let's get this over with. I'll come along peacefully, so leave them alone."

counterexamples.description: Sakura needs only Illya's heart, not necessarily her living company.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All she wants is heart, with accompanying implying acceptance of being killed.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura needs only Illya's heart, not necessarily her living company.

contexts.japanese: 「正気ですか？　わたしが欲しいのは貴女の心臓だけ。
contexts.english: "Are you insane? All I want is your heart.

contexts.japanese: わたしと来る、という事は殺されても構わない、という事です」
contexts.english: You're saying that you don't mind me killing you."

counterexamples.description: Illya explicitly limits Sakura's superiority to now.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Emphasized 今は says for the present Sakura strongest, resistance pointless.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya explicitly limits Sakura's superiority to now.

contexts.japanese: 「そんなの判ってるわ。けどどっちにしたって殺されるんだし、抵抗しても無駄でしょ。とりあえず、今はサクラが一番強いんだし」
contexts.english: "I know that. But I'm going to get killed regardless, so it's pointless to resist. For now, you're the strongest one here."

counterexamples.description: Sakura suspects Illya's ulterior scheme while accepting.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Doesn't know her plan but goes along with persuasive talk.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura suspects Illya's ulterior scheme while accepting.

contexts.japanese: どんな思惑かは知らないけど、貴女の口車に乗ってあげます」
contexts.english: I don't know what you're playing at, but I'll go along with it."

counterexamples.description: Illya assigns end of Shirou's role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His turn ends, aftermath her responsibility.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya assigns end of Shirou's role.

contexts.japanese: 「サクラの言う通りよ。シロウの出番はこれで終わり。
contexts.english: "Sakura's right. Your role in this is done, Shirou.

counterexamples.description: Emotionally consequential big-brother farewell survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She calls him お兄ちゃん and says time together fun.
counterexamples.explanation: Emotionally consequential big-brother farewell survives.

contexts.japanese: 「—じゃあね。今まで楽しかったよ、お兄ちゃん」
contexts.english: "Bye. It's been fun, big brother."

counterexamples.description: Guilt over seeing Sakura as someone else is released.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Farewell thaws fear paralysis and clears guilt for denying Sakura identity.
counterexamples.explanation: Guilt over seeing Sakura as someone else is released.

contexts.japanese: 桜を別人だと思ってしまった負い目も消え去った。
contexts.english: and my guilt for thinking Sakura was someone else finally stop.

contexts.japanese: それで全てが解凍した。
contexts.english: Finally, I unfreeze.

counterexamples.description: Shadow disappearance is compared to sinking rather than ordinary walking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two girls vanished from his sight as if sinking into Sakura shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow disappearance is compared to sinking rather than ordinary walking.

contexts.japanese: 二人は桜の影に沈むように、俺の視界から消え去っていた。
contexts.english: They vanish from sight, as if sinking into her shadow.

counterexamples.description: Illya rather than Rin identified potential helper.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Knows Berserker Master Illya and trusts she'll listen.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rather than Rin identified potential helper.

contexts.japanese: 「え？　いや、遠坂じゃない。俺、バーサーカーのマスターとは知り合いなんだ。イリヤって言うんだけど、あの娘なら話せばちゃんと聞いてくれる」
contexts.english: "Huh? No, not her. I'm acquainted with Berserker's Master. Her name is Illya, and she'll listen to what I have to say."

counterexamples.description: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strong in direct combat but indirect enemy could endanger Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.

contexts.japanese: となると、バーサーカーを連れたイリヤでも油断はできない。
contexts.english: So, Illya can't get careless, even if she has Berserker.

counterexamples.description: Half-day arrival estimate is belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remembers guided route, broad forest maybe difficult, should reach half-day.
counterexamples.explanation: Half-day arrival estimate is belief.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、前に見せられた。道順は記憶している。広い森なんで想像通りにはいかないだろうが、半日もあれば辿り着ける筈だ」
contexts.english: "Yeah, she showed me before. I still remember the way there. It was a really big forest, so I'm sure it won't be easy to get there, but it should take about half a day."

counterexamples.description: Early return-by-night promise stays prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Leaving now should permit return before night.
counterexamples.explanation: Early return-by-night promise stays prospective.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。善は急げって言うし、今から行けば夜までには帰ってこれる」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It's better to strike while the iron's hot, and if I go now, I can be back by nightfall."

counterexamples.description: Sakura's forest warning remains unfinished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest now... interrupted before complete explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's forest warning remains unfinished.

contexts.japanese: 「…………けど、先輩だって危険です。あの森は、いま」
contexts.english: "...But you're in danger, too. That forest is..."

counterexamples.description: No-longer-Master safety assertion remains boy's argument.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says not Master so Illya uninterested, will flee if danger.
counterexamples.explanation: No-longer-Master safety assertion remains boy's argument.

contexts.japanese: 「心配すんな。危ないって思ったらすぐに逃げる。それにイリヤはマスター以外に興味はないんだ。マスターじゃなくなった俺がいっても危険はない」
contexts.english: "Don't worry. If it looks dangerous, I'll run away immediately. Illya doesn't have any interest in people who aren't Masters, anyway. I won't be in any danger."

counterexamples.description: Route memory and intuition from magic remain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No map/compass, guidance from Illya magic, relies memory and instinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Route memory and intuition from magic remain.

contexts.japanese: もともとイリヤの魔術によって得た直感である。なら、頼りになるのは見せられた記憶と、自身の直感だけだろう。
contexts.english: I still have the sense of direction I got from the magecraft Illya cast on me. All I can do is rely on the memory of what I saw, and my own intuition.

contexts.japanese: 地図、コンパスといった物は持ってこなかった。
contexts.english: I don't have a map or a compass.

counterexamples.description: Earliest arrival before sundown retains uncertainty.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At shortest can reach castle before dusk, decide afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Earliest arrival before sundown retains uncertainty.

contexts.japanese: —最短で行けば日暮れ前にイリヤの城に着ける。
contexts.english: If all goes well, I should make it to Illya's castle before sundown.

counterexamples.description: Taxi hail is first actual departure step.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Now heads intersection to get cab, outskirts/forest search after.
counterexamples.explanation: Taxi hail is first actual departure step.

contexts.japanese: まずは交差点まで降りて、タクシーを拾う。
contexts.english: First I need to go to the intersection and hail a taxi.

counterexamples.description: First physical visit and magically familiar entrance coexist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest entrance new to his own eyes but familiar from Illya viewpoint.
counterexamples.explanation: First physical visit and magically familiar entrance coexist.

contexts.japanese: 初見にして見覚えのある森の入り口は、日中だというのに朝靄のように白ばんでいた。
contexts.english: I find the forest entrance, which feels familiar despite this being my first time seeing it, shrouded in mist even during daytime.

counterexamples.description: Four-hour route remains remembered experience.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Through Illya's eyes journey took roughly four hours from entrance.
counterexamples.explanation: Four-hour route remains remembered experience.

contexts.japanese: イリヤの“眼”から見た時、城まではここからざっと四時間ほどだった。
contexts.english: When I was seeing through Illya's "eyes," it took roughly four hours to get to the castle from here.

counterexamples.description: Sparse wildlife is attributed tentatively to Einzbern magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Probably their magecraft causes absence of living presence.
counterexamples.explanation: Sparse wildlife is attributed tentatively to Einzbern magic.

contexts.japanese: 生き物の気配が希薄なのは、アインツベルンの魔術によるものなのだろう。
contexts.english: The lack of local wildlife is probably due to Einzbern magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Present forest differs from shared memory as impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels atmosphere unlike Illya's view.
counterexamples.explanation: Present forest differs from shared memory as impression.

contexts.japanese: 「……にしても。この森、イリヤに見せてもらった時と様子が違う気がする」
contexts.english: "Still, though...this forest feels different from what Illya showed me."

counterexamples.description: Rin's fighting answer remains hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If she were here to fight, Shirou lacks formal stake as non-Master.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's fighting answer remains hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 「……だとしたらどうなの。貴方はもうマスターじゃない。なら、わたしたちの戦いに首をつっこむ資格も義理もない筈よ」
contexts.english: "...So what if I am? You aren't a Master anymore. You don't have the right or obligation to stick your neck out into our battles."

counterexamples.description: Sakura alliance is only one motive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He admits alliance plan but objects to harm too.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura alliance is only one motive.

contexts.japanese: 「なんでよ。もしかしてイリヤと桜を組ませるってハラ？」
contexts.english: "Why? Are you trying to get her to team up with Sakura?"

counterexamples.description: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says earlier shot in dark; now recognizes plan talk Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.

contexts.japanese: 「いいからいいから。で、その格好からするに衛宮くんもイリヤスフィールに用が有るってワケね。さっきはあてずっぽうで言ったけど、ホントにイリヤスフィールと話し合いをするつもりなんだ」
contexts.english: "All right, settle down. From the looks of it, you've got some business with Illyasviel. I was just taking a shot in the dark earlier, but you really do intend to talk to her."

counterexamples.description: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If possible cooperate; immediate objective Zouken, came to warn Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.

contexts.japanese: 「売らないわよ？　イリヤスフィールと共闘できるなら、それに越した事はないもの。とりあえずやるべき事は臓硯の排除でしょ。わたしがここに来たのは、イリヤスフィールに忠告に来ただけだもの」
contexts.english: "I won't, not if she's willing to form a common front. First order of things is to eliminate Zouken, right? I just came here to give her a warning."

counterexamples.description: Rin prepared for warning to trigger combat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She doubts direct dialogue and accepts possible fight after warning.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prepared for warning to trigger combat.

contexts.japanese: けど、そう忠告したところで戦いになるって覚悟してたけどね。わたしとあの子じゃ話し合いなんて出来ない。
contexts.english: But I'm ready for it to turn into a fight once I warn her. I can't have a dialogue with that girl.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's option can remove fight risk.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he has prospect, no need dangerous gamble; his effort may settle peacefully.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's option can remove fight risk.

contexts.japanese: 「でも、見たところ衛宮くんには当てがありそうじゃない？　なら冒険をする必要もないし、衛宮くんの努力次第で事は丸く収まるってこと」
contexts.english: "But it sounds like you have another option. In that case, I don't need to take the risk of fighting her. Depending on how well you do, we might settle everything peacefully."

counterexamples.description: Successful persuasion means Rin leaves.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he persuades Illya, Rin withdraws peacefully.
counterexamples.explanation: Successful persuasion means Rin leaves.

contexts.japanese: 「ほら、難しい顔しないっ。貴方がイリヤスフィールを説得できるなら、わたしは大人しく帰ってあげる。
contexts.english: "Come on, don't give me that look. If you can persuade her, then I'll leave peacefully.

counterexamples.description: Rin promises not to interrupt negotiations.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Limited cooperation while Shirou talks, interrupted before ally assessment finishes.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin promises not to interrupt negotiations.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ、貴方がイリヤスフィールと交渉している間も邪魔はしないわ。あの子、敵に回したら厄介だけど味方にできるなら頼もし—」
contexts.english: "Yeah, I won't interfere in your negotiations with her. She's a pain to deal with as an enemy, but if we can be allies—"

counterexamples.description: Illya safety plea remains a wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells/hopes she be safe while chasing.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya safety plea remains a wish.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ、無事でいろよ…………！」
contexts.english: "Be safe, Illya...!"

counterexamples.description: Illya fears nonreturn after capture by opponent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Orders escape, no more fighting; being got means cannot come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya fears nonreturn after capture by opponent.

contexts.japanese: 「だめ、逃げるのバーサーカー……！　そいつにやられたら戻ってこれなくなる……！　もう戦わなくていいから、早く……！」
contexts.english: "No, Berserker! Run! If that gets you, you won't be able to come back to me! You don't have to fight anymore!"

counterexamples.description: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken withdraws, tells Assassin bring Illya after Shadow consumes Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.

contexts.japanese: 後は任せたぞアサシン。これ以上ここにおっては巻き添えをくらいかねん。バーサーカーが呑まれ次第、アインツベルンの娘を捕らえ戻ってくるがよい」
contexts.english: Take care of the rest, Assassin. It is too risky for me to remain here any longer. Once it consumes Berserker, capture and bring back the Einzbern girl."

counterexamples.description: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow consumes visible things especially magical masses; captive must not be swallowed.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.

contexts.japanese: それが魔力の塊ならば尚の事だ。アインツベルンの娘、むざむざ呑まれる事のないようにな」
contexts.english: Especially any dense sources of magical energy. Be careful not to let the Einzbern girl be taken, too."

counterexamples.description: Illya runs heedless toward Berserker and spreading Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: As if unable see danger, single-minded advance.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya runs heedless toward Berserker and spreading Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 巨人の足元に広がる影が見えないかのように、一心にバーサーカーへと走り出す。
contexts.english: She starts running desperately towards Berserker, as if she can't see the spreading Shadow at his feet.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Intervention seems futile against Shadow or swordsman.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”にも黒い剣士にも勝てる見込みなんてない。
contexts.english: I don't have a chance of winning against the Shadow or the swordsman.

counterexamples.description: Illya raises castle defenses before threat arrives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Senses great approaching enemy, maximizes barriers and wakes giant.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya raises castle defenses before threat arrives.

contexts.japanese: それが強大なものと感じ取れるが故に、少女は城の防壁を最大にし、現れるであろう“敵”に備えて巨人を起こした。
contexts.english: When she sensed how great the threat was, she raised the castle's defenses to maximum and woke up the giant in preparation for its arrival.

counterexamples.description: Her confidence is self-reassurance over dread.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tells herself defenses enough to cap anxiety.
counterexamples.explanation: Her confidence is self-reassurance over dread.

contexts.japanese: そう自分に言い聞かせて、少女は堪えきれない不安に蓋をした。
contexts.english: That's what she told herself as she tried to fight down the sense of inevitable dread.

counterexamples.description: Speechless Berserker independently perceives unwinnable danger.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even deprived reason/words communicates flight.
counterexamples.explanation: Speechless Berserker independently perceives unwinnable danger.

contexts.japanese: 理性を奪われ、口を閉ざした筈の狂戦士でさえ、目前に迫った“何か”には勝てないと悟ったのだ。
contexts.english: Robbed of his sanity and speech, even the mad warrior sensed that he couldn't win against whatever was coming for them.

counterexamples.description: Fear concerns losing Berserker rather than defeat alone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Flight motivated by Servant ceasing hers.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear concerns losing Berserker rather than defeat alone.

contexts.japanese: 少女は敗北ではなく、自らのサーヴァントを失う事を恐れて城から逃げだした。
contexts.english: The girl ran because she was afraid of losing her Servant, not losing the fight.

counterexamples.description: Illya recognizes Zouken from homeland instruction, not prior meeting.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At glance matches Makiri-associated magus taught before departure.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya recognizes Zouken from homeland instruction, not prior meeting.

contexts.japanese: それが故郷の城を出る時に教えられた、同朋の魔術師である事は一目で判った。
contexts.english: She recognizes him with a single look as a mage of the Makiris, whom she was taught about when she left the castle in her homeland.

counterexamples.description: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and giant fear something else.
counterexamples.explanation: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.

contexts.japanese: 少女と巨人が脅威を感じたモノは、間違っても目前の敵ではないのだから。
contexts.english: The threat that she and the giant felt is most certainly not the person in front of them.

counterexamples.description: Public ritual premise is explicitly distorted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters-chosen/Servants-formed story deliberately transmitted crookedly.
counterexamples.explanation: Public ritual premise is explicitly distorted.

contexts.japanese: その前提は、意図的に歪められて伝わったものだ。
contexts.english: That rule—that pretext was deliberately distorted and spread.

counterexamples.description: Masters and Servants retain ritual-component roles.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters prepared as one part; Servants open gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Masters and Servants retain ritual-component roles.

contexts.japanese: マスターは選ばれるのではなく、ただ儀式の一端として用意されるだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Masters are not chosen. They are merely components of a ritual.

contexts.japanese: そしてサーヴァントとは、ただ門を開ける為だけのもの—
contexts.english: Likewise, Servants are merely used to open the gate...

counterexamples.description: Vessel and Greater Grail wills remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Vessel no will; Greater Grail selects Masters.
counterexamples.explanation: Vessel and Greater Grail wills remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 器になる聖杯に意思はないけど、マスターを選び出す大聖杯には意思があるわ。もともとこの土地に原型があるからこそ、貴方たちは英霊を呼び出して聖杯を満たそうとした。
contexts.english: The vessel has no will of it own, but the Greater Grail which selects the Masters does. You summon Heroic Spirits to fill the Holy Grail because its prototype is here, on this land.

counterexamples.description: Next-ritual plan advanced by favorable pieces.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Intended next ceremony but current pawns allow one remaining move.
counterexamples.explanation: Next-ritual plan advanced by favorable pieces.

contexts.japanese: 「いやいや、心配には及ばぬ。マキリの衰退もここまでよ。事は成りつつあってな。予定では次の儀式で行う筈じゃったが、今回は駒に恵まれての。ワシの悲願はあと一手で叶おうとしておる」
contexts.english: "My, my. There's no need for concern. The decline of the Makiris ends here. Our endeavor is nearly complete. I had planned to finish it in the next ritual, but I've been blessed with capable pawns. I'm only one step away from my long-cherished goal."

counterexamples.description: Illya's body is sought as insurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Too-smooth progress breeds anxiety; seizing vessel secures goal.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's body is sought as insurance.

contexts.japanese: だが—やはりのう、こうも上手くいきすぎると逆に不安が大きくなる。万が一のため、おぬしの体を貰い受ける。ここで聖杯を押さえておけば、我が悲願は磐石じゃ」
contexts.english: But...I can't help but feel anxious when things go so smoothly. Just in case, I'll be taking your body, too. If I can seize you here, then my wish is all but granted."

counterexamples.description: Decay complaint remains Zouken's argument.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks if she knows crumbling-alive pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Decay complaint remains Zouken's argument.

contexts.japanese: —その痛み。生きながら崩れ行く苦しみがおぬしにわかるか？」
contexts.english: How could you possibly comprehend this pain, this suffering of a constantly crumbling life?"

counterexamples.description: Illya frames decay as self-incurred price.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Human body not endure century; beyond incurs cost; death would end pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya frames decay as self-incurred price.

contexts.japanese: 「……自業自得でしょう。人の体は百年の時間に耐えられない。それを超えようというのだから、代償は必要だわ。それに耐えられないなら消えればいい。苦しいのなら、死ねば楽になるんじゃなくて？」
contexts.english: "...You brought that on yourself. The human body can barely last a hundred years. To go beyond that, you have to pay a price. If you can't endure it, then disappear. Death will end your suffering, you know."

counterexamples.description: Illya's under-year lifespan claim stays attributed to Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls body hastily made, won't operate another year.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's under-year lifespan claim stays attributed to Zouken.

contexts.japanese: だからこそおぬしは人形にすぎぬのだ。その急造の体ではあと一年と稼動つまい。短命に定められた作り物に、人間の欲望は理解できぬという事だ……！」
contexts.english: That is what makes you a mere puppet. Your hastily built body won't last another year. How can a creation designed to live a short life possibly comprehend human desire!?"

counterexamples.description: World-sacrifice universalization remains Zouken's speech.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He claims any human would take survival at any cost.
counterexamples.explanation: World-sacrifice universalization remains Zouken's speech.

contexts.japanese: 最期に知っておけ。目の前に生き延びる手段があり、手を伸ばせば届くというのなら—何者をも、たとえ世界そのものを犠牲にしても手に入れるのが人間だとな……！」
contexts.english: Know this. If there is any way to still live, then anyone would reach for it, even if it means sacrificing the entire world! That is what it means to be human...!"

counterexamples.description: Illya exposes universal sacrifice implication.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Asks whether he would sacrifice all others for own life.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya exposes universal sacrifice implication.

contexts.japanese: 「—じゃあ、貴方は自分が生き続けるために、他の人間をみんな犠牲にするっていうの？」
contexts.english: "Then you'd willingly sacrifice everyone else so that you can keep on living?"

counterexamples.description: Forest analogy escalates to all trees.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unsated desire expands from forest to world trees.
counterexamples.explanation: Forest analogy escalates to all trees.

contexts.japanese: その願望は、この森だけでは飽き足らず世界中の木々を殺す事になろう」
contexts.english: And your desire would not be sated by a single forest. You would kill all the trees in the world."

counterexamples.description: Changed voice is described without possession claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Girl speaks in voice unlike girl's.
counterexamples.explanation: Changed voice is described without possession claim.

contexts.japanese: 少女は、少女の声ではない声でそう言った。
contexts.english: The girl speaks in a voice very unlike that of a girl.

counterexamples.description: Original miracle aspiration remains an unanswered question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Asks where shared earnest wish came from and its purpose.
counterexamples.explanation: Original miracle aspiration remains an unanswered question.

contexts.japanese: 「思い出しなさい。わたしたちの悲願、奇跡に至ろうとする切望は何処からきたものなのか。
contexts.english: "Remember. Where did our wish, our earnest hope to achieve a miracle, come from?

counterexamples.description: Illya's question interrupts Zouken's laughter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He stops and momentarily reacts before dismissal.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's question interrupts Zouken's laughter.

contexts.japanese: 哄笑が止まる。
contexts.english: The laughter dies.

counterexamples.description: Zouken wants body and rejects mind.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ends discussion, claims Einzbern vessel.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken wants body and rejects mind.

contexts.japanese: 「—もうよい。戯れはここまでじゃ。おぬしの体は要るが、心になど用はない。アインツベルンの聖杯、この間桐臓硯が貰い受ける」
contexts.english: "Enough. Playtime is over. I want your body, but I have no use for your mind. I, Zouken Makiri, will take the Einzbern Grail."

counterexamples.description: Berserker attacks without waiting for Master's command.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Independent sortie despite her recall.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker attacks without waiting for Master's command.

contexts.japanese: 黒い巨人は、少女の命を待たずして出陣した。
contexts.english: The dark giant moves out without waiting for his Master's command.

contexts.japanese: 「だめ……！　戻ってバーサーカー……！」
contexts.english: "No...! Come back, Berserker!"

contexts.japanese: 少女の声は届かず。
contexts.english: Her voice doesn't reach him.

counterexamples.description: Assassin pursues through trees behind group.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin ahead, Shirou with Illya, Assassin rear.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin pursues through trees behind group.

contexts.japanese: 背後には、木々をすり抜けて追ってくるアサシンの気配。
contexts.english: I can sense Assassin chasing us through the trees.

counterexamples.description: Illya's presence obstructs escape.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot shake Servant pursuer while carrying/leading her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's presence obstructs escape.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを連れた状態ではどうやって振り払—
contexts.english: How am I supposed to shake him off with Illya in tow?

counterexamples.description: Assassin rejects Shirou as target.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At Shirou's ear says you are not needed.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin rejects Shirou as target.

contexts.japanese: 「—そこまでだ。オマエは要らない」
contexts.english: "That's far enough. I don't need you."

counterexamples.description: Taking Illya's hand creates duty through the end.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer orders boy run/protect her after choosing rescue.
counterexamples.explanation: Taking Illya's hand creates duty through the end.

contexts.japanese: 「詮議は後だ。走れ小僧。イリヤの手を取ったからには、最後まで守り通せ」
contexts.english: "Save the discussion for later. Run, boy. Now that you've taken Illya's hand, protect her til the very end."

counterexamples.description: Apologetic gaze targets Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer looks terribly sorry at her while falling back.
counterexamples.explanation: Apologetic gaze targets Illya.

contexts.japanese: 去り行く寸前、アーチャーはひどく済まなそうな目で、イリヤを見つめていた。
contexts.english: Just before he leaves, he looks at Illya with a terribly sorry expression.

counterexamples.description: Choice distinguishes each girl's protector.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin has Archer; Illya has nobody, cannot reach both.
counterexamples.explanation: Choice distinguishes each girl's protector.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂にはアーチャーがいて、イリヤには誰もいない。
contexts.english: Tohsaka has Archer, but Illya has nobody else.

counterexamples.description: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Must take his place guarding Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーの代わりを果たさなければ—！
contexts.english: in Berserker's place!

counterexamples.description: He physically covers Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forces her down and shields her body.
counterexamples.explanation: He physically covers Illya.

contexts.japanese: そのまま、イリヤを隠すように覆い被さった瞬間。
contexts.english: Just as I cover her with my body,

counterexamples.description: Right arm resists Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Functioning right side opposes taking Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Right arm resists Shadow.

contexts.japanese: それに、右腕で懸命に抗った。
contexts.english: I use my right arm to resist as best as I can.

counterexamples.description: Illya is explicitly unharmed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Protection succeeds for her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya is explicitly unharmed.

contexts.japanese: ……イリヤは、無事だった。
contexts.english: ...Illya's safe.

counterexamples.description: Argument is interpreted as a form of closeness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou thinks quarrel may mean they get along.
counterexamples.explanation: Argument is interpreted as a form of closeness.

contexts.japanese: あの二人の場合、あれはあれで仲がいい、と見るべきだろう。
contexts.english: You could say they actually get along pretty well.

counterexamples.description: Outside tableau separates Illya and Rin reactions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya chilly skyward; Rin ready complain.
counterexamples.explanation: Outside tableau separates Illya and Rin reactions.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは寒そうに空を見上げていて、遠坂は文句ありそーにこっちを睨んでいたりする。
contexts.english: Illya's gazing up at the sky, looking a little chilly. Meanwhile, Tohsaka's staring at me, and I can tell she's about to complain.

counterexamples.description: Illya initially attacks ownership premise.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Calls claim absurd.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya initially attacks ownership premise.

contexts.japanese: 「な、なに言ってるのよあなた……っ！　そんなコトで所有権を言い出すなんて馬鹿馬鹿しいにも程があるわ！」
contexts.english: "W-what are you talking about!? That's a completely absurd ownership claim!"

counterexamples.description: Illya's actual objection is that Shirou already belongs to her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The joke overturns apparent principle.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's actual objection is that Shirou already belongs to her.

contexts.japanese: 「だいたいリンの言い分は的を外れてるわ。そもそもシロウはわたしのなんだから、リンにあげられるワケない
contexts.english: "You're off base, to begin with. Shirou already belongs to me, so you can't

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes objection targeted wrong point.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Momentary approval corrected.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes objection targeted wrong point.

contexts.japanese: つっこむポイントがすでにズレていたんだな。
contexts.english: She's mad about the wrong thing entirely.

counterexamples.description: Illya claims daily forbearance gives life authority.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says can decide life/death and dismisses Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya claims daily forbearance gives life authority.

contexts.japanese: 「そんなのリンが大人げないだけよ。わたしは毎日見逃してあげてたんだから、シロウの命はわたしのに決まってるわ。生かすのも殺すのもわたしなんだから、関係ないリンは引っ込んでて」
contexts.english: "You just can't control your own temper. I've been letting Shirou run free every day, so his life obviously belongs to me. I get to decide whether he lives or dies. You have nothing to do with it, so back off."

counterexamples.description: Either victor means headache for Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He waits with frown, sees no good ownership outcome.
counterexamples.explanation: Either victor means headache for Shirou.

contexts.japanese: どっちに軍配が上がるにしろ、頭の痛い結果になるコトに変わりはないのだが。
contexts.english: I can tell that no matter who wins, it's going to give me a headache.

counterexamples.description: Question explicitly asks whose Servant he will be.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Women seek his answer rather than completed assignment.
counterexamples.explanation: Question explicitly asks whose Servant he will be.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、どっちのサーヴァントかって言うことよ。士郎の答えをまだ聞いてなかったし、ここではっきりさせた方がいいでしょ」
contexts.english: "I'm asking whose Servant you're going to be. We haven't heard your opinion yet, so we should make it clear now."

counterexamples.description: Illya's coaxing assumes preferred ownership answer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: You're mine, right?
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's coaxing assumes preferred ownership answer.

contexts.japanese: ほら、言ってあげてシロウ。シロウはぁ、わたしのものでいいんだよね？」
contexts.english: Come on, tell her, Shirou. You're mine, right?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou chooses Rin without hesitation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says Tohsaka and that the answer needs no thought.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou chooses Rin without hesitation.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂だよ。そんなの、考えるまでもないだろ」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka. I don't even need to think about that."

counterexamples.description: Illya's suggestive accusation remains teasingly vague.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After caricaturing Rin, she asks whether Shirou is into that sort of thing.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's suggestive accusation remains teasingly vague.

contexts.japanese: 「な、なんで？　リンは横暴で強欲で、おまけに九官鳥みたいにうるさいんだよ？　なのに、シロウはそっちのがいいの？　もしかしてソッチ系なの？」
contexts.english: "W-why? Rin is violent, greedy, and as loud as a mynah. But you still want to be with her? Is that what you're into?"

counterexamples.description: Illya's explanation of Archer's relation to Shirou remains unfinished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She trails off at Archer is Shirou's... without completing the identity.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's explanation of Archer's relation to Shirou remains unfinished.

contexts.japanese: 「それは……アーチャーは、だって、シロウの」
contexts.english: "But... That's only because Archer is your..."

counterexamples.description: The Illya choice is admitted as the first name to come to mind.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou tentatively names her rather than presenting a policy.
counterexamples.explanation: The Illya choice is admitted as the first name to come to mind.

contexts.japanese: あたまに浮かんだ名前を口にする。
contexts.english: I just say the first name that comes to mind.

counterexamples.description: Illya calls Shirou the fortunate one.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The playful かほうもの is directed at him.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya calls Shirou the fortunate one.

contexts.japanese: 「うんうん！　シロウったらかほうものめー！」
contexts.english: "Yeah! You're one lucky duck, Shirou!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou frames his pleasure as that of an older-brother figure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her delight makes him unconditionally happy in that family role.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou frames his pleasure as that of an older-brother figure.

contexts.japanese: その喜ばれようは兄貴分として無条件に嬉しいのだが、
contexts.english: As an older brother figure, I'm more than happy about that,

counterexamples.description: Rin's anger cancels and then outweighs Shirou's joy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His emotional arithmetic moves from zero into the negative.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's anger cancels and then outweighs Shirou's joy.

contexts.japanese: こう、シャレにならないぐらい怒ってる遠坂で嬉しさもプラスマイナスゼロ、いやむしろマイナスに傾いているような。
contexts.english: but Tohsaka doesn't look amused in the slightest. It's enough to cancel out the joy, no, put me in the negative, actually.

counterexamples.description: Illya casts the choice as Rin being dumped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She taunts that Rin lashes out because Shirou rejected her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya casts the choice as Rin being dumped.

contexts.japanese: 「ふふーんだ、見苦しいわよリン。フラレたからって八つ当たりなんて、レディにあるまじき行いだわ。そんなんだからぁ、リンはシロウに嫌われたのでしたぁ」
contexts.english: Heh, you're embarrassing yourself, Rin. It isn't very ladylike to lose your temper just because you got dumped. That's why Shirou doesn't like you.

counterexamples.description: Rin denies Illya's rejected-romance premise.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She insists she only stated social common sense and challenges who dumped whom.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin denies Illya's rejected-romance premise.

contexts.japanese: わたしは世間一般の常識を口にしただけだし、第一、誰が、誰にフラレたっていうのよ……！」
contexts.english: I'm just stating normal social values, and first of all, who are you calling dumped...!?"

counterexamples.description: Illya promises to protect Shirou from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The promise escalates the ownership quarrel and is framed against anything Rin might do.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya promises to protect Shirou from Rin.

contexts.japanese: けど安心して、リンが何かしてきたら、これからはわたしが守ってあげるから！」
contexts.english: But don't worry. I'll protect you, no matter what she tries!"

counterexamples.description: Rin's gaze makes Shirou feel beyond defense.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His doubled happiness is offset by her extremely cold look.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's gaze makes Shirou feel beyond defense.

contexts.japanese: ……あやつの視線が、もう弁明の余地を許さないほど冷たいのをどうにかしてくれ。
contexts.english: ...But now I'm getting a look so cold and judgmental I can't possibly defend myself against it, so can we move on?

counterexamples.description: Shirou admits he does not know why he chose Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The answer was intuitive and opaque even to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou admits he does not know why he chose Illya.

contexts.japanese: 直感で答えたというか、自分でもイリヤを選んだ理由が判っていなかった。
contexts.english: Even I'm not really sure why I chose Illya. It's like it happened on instinct.

counterexamples.description: The guardian justification is blurted defensively.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou denies the insinuation, says he simply felt it, then argues his guardian role makes the choice natural.
counterexamples.explanation: The guardian justification is blurted defensively.

contexts.japanese: 「わ、わけあるかばかものーっ！　ささ、さっきのはなんとなくそう思ったから口にしただけというか、俺はイリヤの保護者になったんだからイリヤを取るのは当然だ文句あるかっ……！」
contexts.english: "L-like hell I am, idiot! I just picked her because I felt like it. I'm basically Illya's guardian now anyway, so it only makes sense I'd choose her...!"

counterexamples.description: Stopping Illya remains the immediate priority.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou acts despite the battle spectacle.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping Illya remains the immediate priority.

contexts.japanese: それでも—今は、イリヤを止めないと……！
contexts.english: But still...right now, I have to stop Illya!

counterexamples.description: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The blast/wind overwhelms him, but the rescue grip remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを抱きかかえ、暴風に耐え切れず地面に倒れる。
contexts.english: The wind pushes me to the ground, Illya still in my arms.

counterexamples.description: Shirou prepares the available right arm while holding Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This wording precedes later left-arm loss and does not itself certify amputation.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou prepares the available right arm while holding Illya.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを一層強く抱きしめ、残った右腕に力を込める。
contexts.english: I hold on tight to Illya, and tense my right arm.

counterexamples.description: The demand for Illya is read from Saber's eyes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber does not voice it.
counterexamples.explanation: The demand for Illya is read from Saber's eyes.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを渡さなければ殺す、と絶対の意思を告げていた。
contexts.english: They declare that she'll kill me unless I hand Illya over.

counterexamples.description: Illya's release is interpreted as permission to surrender her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The seeming implication triggers Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's release is interpreted as permission to surrender her.

contexts.japanese: それが—自分を差し出していい、と言っているようで、最後のスイッチが入った。
contexts.english: The gesture seems to say that it's okay to hand her over. It flips a switch inside me.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's left hand is free and placed on the wooden sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both hands are available at this point.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's left hand is free and placed on the wooden sword.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを後ろに押しのけて、自由になった左手を木刀に添える。
contexts.english: I push Illya back and take hold of my wooden sword with my now free left hand.

counterexamples.description: Shirou takes Illya's hand and flees.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This begins the escape leading to the later rear-guard sequence.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou takes Illya's hand and flees.

contexts.japanese: イリヤの手を取って走り出す。
contexts.english: I take Illya's hand and run.

counterexamples.description: Twenty minutes have passed since parting from Rin and Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The elapsed time frames the delayed return.
counterexamples.explanation: Twenty minutes have passed since parting from Rin and Illya.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂たちと別れてからもう二十分。
contexts.english: It's already been twenty minutes since I parted ways with Tohsaka and Illya.

counterexamples.description: Shirou says he failed to help Sakura despite his arm being salvaged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His judgment is about usefulness to her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou says he failed to help Sakura despite his arm being salvaged.

contexts.japanese: 腕はなんとかなったけど、桜の役には立てなかった」
contexts.english: My arm got fixed somehow, but I couldn't help you."

counterexamples.description: Shirou criticizes the adequacy of Illya's rescue, not her survival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says he could not save her satisfactorily and only fled home.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou criticizes the adequacy of Illya's rescue, not her survival.

contexts.japanese: 「う……いや、これがほんっとーに情けなかったんで、そう言われると辛い。満足にイリヤも助けられなかったし、ただ逃げ帰ってくるだけだったし」
contexts.english: "Oof... I really was pathetic back there, so it hurts to hear that. I couldn't help Illya as much as I wanted. All I could do was run away."

counterexamples.description: Illya stands silently and tensely behind Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her mood contrasts with the doorway comedy.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya stands silently and tensely behind Rin.

contexts.japanese: 妙な緊迫感で押し黙ったイリヤの姿もあった。
contexts.english: I see Illya standing silently, looking very tense.

counterexamples.description: Illya rejects proximity through an unnamed deictic insult.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The local household context points toward Sakura, but the source does not name her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rejects proximity through an unnamed deictic insult.

contexts.japanese: 「別にどこでもいいけど、そこの女の近くはイヤよ」
contexts.english: "It doesn't really matter, but not close to her."

counterexamples.description: Rin assigns Illya a Japanese-style room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No exact distance or floor plan is asserted.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin assigns Illya a Japanese-style room.

contexts.japanese: 「そうなの？　ならイリヤは和室ね」
contexts.english: "Is that so? You can have the tatami room, then."

counterexamples.description: Illya initially gives no answer about a room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her silence distinguishes this room-assignment branch.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya initially gives no answer about a room.

counterexamples.description: Illya denies that she was happy to stay.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The denial follows Rin's recollection and functions as withdrawal, not corrected omniscient fact.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya denies that she was happy to stay.

contexts.japanese: 「……知らない。わたしは別に、喜んでなんかなかったわ」
contexts.english: "I don't what you're talking about. I wasn't that excited."

counterexamples.description: A tiny threshold appears emotionally like a high wall.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The comparison externalizes Illya's inability to cross comfortably.
counterexamples.explanation: A tiny threshold appears emotionally like a high wall.

contexts.japanese: ……たった数センチの段差が、高い壁だと言うかのように。
contexts.english: ...It's as if the centimeters-high step is a high wall.

counterexamples.description: Illya asks where the unnamed woman sleeps.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The next narration identifies her glare at Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya asks where the unnamed woman sleeps.

contexts.japanese: 一つ訊くけど、その女は何処で寝てるの」
contexts.english: Where is that woman sleeping?"

counterexamples.description: Illya sends Rin to the annex without her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will accept anywhere outside Sakura's location.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya sends Rin to the annex without her.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。なら離れにはリンだけでいって。離れ以外だったら、わたしはどこでもいいわ」
contexts.english: "Okay. Then Rin can stay there. I'll sleep anywhere besides the guesthouse."

counterexamples.description: Shirou infers closeness from nickname and easy conversation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The degree of intimacy is speculative.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou infers closeness from nickname and easy conversation.

contexts.japanese: もう愛称で呼ぶほど親密になったのか、遠坂とイリヤは気楽に言葉を交わしている。
contexts.english: Tohsaka and Illya casually banter. They seem close enough to be on a first-name basis now.

counterexamples.description: The shared view places Shirou and Illya about five meters from Rin and Archer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The spatial tableau precedes the Shadow expansion.
counterexamples.explanation: The shared view places Shirou and Illya about five meters from Rin and Archer.

contexts.japanese: そこから五メートルほど離れた場所に、銀髪の少女と、手を繋いで立ち尽くす衛宮士郎の姿があった。
contexts.english: Five meters away from them stands a silver-haired girl holding hands with Shirou Emiya.

counterexamples.description: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The viewpoint does not confuse Illya with Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は銀髪の少女を庇って、左腕を影に呑まれた。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya protected the silver-haired girl, and the Shadow swallowed his arm.

counterexamples.description: Illya's safety brings genuine relief before self-assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou remains confused about his own condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's safety brings genuine relief before self-assessment.

contexts.japanese: 状況は掴めないが、イリヤが無事なのは本当に嬉しい。
contexts.english: I don't know what's going on yet, but I'm really happy that Illya is all right.

counterexamples.description: Illya rushes directly into Shirou's arms.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her relief is physical and immediate.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rushes directly into Shirou's arms.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはまっすぐに突っ込んでくる。
contexts.english: Illya dives into my arms.

counterexamples.description: Illya's replacement offer is prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No second procedure has occurred.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's replacement offer is prospective.

contexts.japanese: 「怪我は痛まない？　少しでもおかしいなって思ったら、すぐ代わりの物をつけさせるから！」
contexts.english: "Do your injuries hurt? If anything feels off at all, let me know and I'll get you a replacement right away!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou denies pain immediately before the attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The contradiction dramatizes delayed onset.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou denies pain immediately before the attack.

contexts.japanese: 「……？　ああ、別に痛いところなんてないよ。それよりイリヤ、あれからどうなったのか説明—」
contexts.english: "...? No, it doesn't really hurt anywhere. Anyway, Illya, can you explain what—"

counterexamples.description: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The instruction concerns containment.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ……！？　落ち着いて、我慢するんじゃなくて左腕を抑えつけるの……！」
contexts.english: "Shirou...!? Try to relax. You need to suppress the left arm, not just put up with it...!"

counterexamples.description: Illya judges that mutual rejection has temporarily stopped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her assessment remains cautious.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya judges that mutual rejection has temporarily stopped.

contexts.japanese: 「うん、わたしにも判るよ。どうなる事かと思ったけど、とりあえず反発しあう事はないみたい」
contexts.english: "Good, I can tell, too. I was worried what might happen, but you don't seem to be rejecting it."

counterexamples.description: Illya looks away because explanation is difficult.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei then takes over.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya looks away because explanation is difficult.

contexts.japanese: 言いにくそうに視線を逸らす。
contexts.english: She looks away uncomfortably.

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses to leave Shirou alone with Kirei.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says she will leave with Shirou and challenges the priest's harmlessness.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses to leave Shirou alone with Kirei.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん、どうだか。わたしはシロウと一緒に外に出るの。アナタが本当に何もしないのなら、わたしがここにいても問題はないでしょう？」
contexts.english: "...Hmph, sure you will. I'm going to leave with Shirou. If you really aren't going to do anything to him, then there shouldn't be a problem if I stay."

counterexamples.description: Illya distinguishes spiritual healing from ordinary bodily medicine.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She recognizes Kirei's genuine skill.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya distinguishes spiritual healing from ordinary bodily medicine.

contexts.japanese: 「繋げるだけなら出来なくもないわ。霊媒の医師は肉体ではなく魂を癒すものだっていうし、そこの神父は見かけによらず本物だったっていう事ね」
contexts.english: "It isn't impossible to connect them. It's said that spiritual healers treat the soul, not the body, and that priest turned out to be a real one, despite all appearances."

counterexamples.description: Illya knows Shirou and Archer are exceptional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She withholds the reason.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya knows Shirou and Archer are exceptional.

contexts.japanese: 「……シロウとアーチャーは特別よ。わたしもさっき判った。この二人なら、繋がりさえすれば持ち直すって」
contexts.english: "...But you and Archer are special. I just realized that earlier, too. If it was you two, you'd be able to bounce back."

counterexamples.description: Illya says the castle and attendants remain available.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Homelessness is not her problem.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya says the castle and attendants remain available.

contexts.japanese: 「？　城はまだあるし、セラもリズも呼べば出てくるから帰る場所はあるけど……どうしてそんなコト訊くの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: "Hm? I still have my castle. Sella and Leys will come out if I call for them, so I still have a place to go home too... Why are you asking?"

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses Shirou's house because the woman is there.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The unnamed reference remains pointed.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses Shirou's house because the woman is there.

contexts.japanese: 「いいけど、行かない。シロウのとこにはあの女がいるもの」
contexts.english: "Okay, but I'm not coming. That woman is at your house."

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses Kirei and asserts control of her lodging.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The three parties reject his custody for their own reasons.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses Kirei and asserts control of her lodging.

contexts.japanese: 「お断りするわ。わたし、自分の居場所は自分で決められるもの」
contexts.english: "No thanks. I'll decide where I'm going to stay."

counterexamples.description: Illya also refuses the Tohsaka house as Einzbern Master.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Factional pride remains comic and serious.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya also refuses the Tohsaka house as Einzbern Master.

contexts.japanese: 「バ、バカ言わないでっ……！　アインツベルンのマスターは、遠坂の家になんていかないんだからっ！」
contexts.english: "D-don't be stupid! An Einzbern Master would never live at the Tohsaka house!"

counterexamples.description: Illya claims she can manage without Berserker.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is her assertion, not verified safety.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya claims she can manage without Berserker.

contexts.japanese: 「わかってるわ。もとからあそこがわたしの工房なんだから、他のマスターの世話になんてならない。バーサーカーがいなくたって、わたしは一人でやってくんだから」
contexts.english: "I know that. That's my atelier to begin with, so I don't need to rely on other Masters for help. I can take care of myself even without Berserker."

counterexamples.description: Illya protests that Rin's accusations are not her words.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is deliberately paraphrasing to provoke her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya protests that Rin's accusations are not her words.

contexts.japanese: わたしそんなコト一言も—」
contexts.english: I never said..."

counterexamples.description: Illya says she must stay away from Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The underlying reason remains incomplete.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya says she must stay away from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「……それは、そうだけど……けど、わたしが城に戻るのは、シロウから離れないといけないからで—」
contexts.english: "That's true, but... But I need to go back to the castle because I should stay away from Shirou..."

counterexamples.description: Illya emphatically denies disliking Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says something else is the problem.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya emphatically denies disliking Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「そ、そんなコトないっ！　わたし、シロウがイヤだなんて言ってないもん！　わたしがイヤなのは、もっと別のコトなんだから……！」
contexts.english: "Th-that's not true! I never said that I don't like Shirou! There's something else that I don't like...!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou's house is chosen as shared base for practical reasons.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya rejects Rin's house and Sakura already lives with Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's house is chosen as shared base for practical reasons.

contexts.japanese: 「当たり前でしょう。これから共同戦線を張るんだから、一緒にいなくてどうするのよ。うちはイリヤが嫌がるし、そっちには桜もいるし、どう考えても本拠地は貴方の家でしょ」
contexts.english: "Obviously. We're going to be fighting together, so we need to actually be together. Illya doesn't like my house, and Sakura's already at your place, so that makes your house our base of operations."

counterexamples.description: Illya accompanies Rin because Rin requested help.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will come to Shirou's house afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya accompanies Rin because Rin requested help.

contexts.japanese: 「ん、ちょっとね。リンが手を貸してほしいって言うから助けてあげるの。終わったらすぐ行くから、シロウは先に帰っていて」
contexts.english: "I'll just be a bit. Rin said she needed my help with something. I'll come over as soon as we're finished, so go on home first, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Rin hopes not to find the suspected inheritance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If it is what she imagines, she cannot handle it alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin hopes not to find the suspected inheritance.

contexts.japanese: ……けど、出来れば見つけたくない。遠坂の遺産、大師父の置き土産が想像通りのものなら、わたしだけじゃどうにもならないから」
contexts.english: ...Though, I'd like to avoid digging up any Tohsaka heirlooms if we can help it. If Grandmaster Kischur's souvenirs are what I think they are, I can't handle them by myself."

counterexamples.description: Illya pivots and runs after Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The skirt movement preserves childlike physical energy.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya pivots and runs after Rin.

contexts.japanese: くるり、とスカートをなびかせてイリヤは走っていく。
contexts.english: Illya pivots and runs after Tohsaka, her skirt fluttering.

counterexamples.description: Shirou introduces Illya as rescued and staying in the house.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Berserker's defeat and the new arrangement remain.
